66316.recognize_zh: 上排椎體病灶切片（A–C）為近乎全細胞性骨髓，巨核細胞明顯增加且大小不一、成鬆散群聚（CD61 染色凸顯），下排髂骨切片（D–F）則是正常細胞密度、巨核細胞稀疏散在；同一 JAK2 突變在兩處呈現截然不同型態，提示局灶性 MPN 樣病變。
features: Panel A–B (vertebral lesion, H&E): near 100% cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and markedly increased megakaryocytes
Megakaryocytes are large with abundant cytoplasm and hyperlobulated/staghorn-like nuclei, forming loose clusters
Panel C (CD61 IHC): numerous large CD61-positive megakaryocytes in clusters
Panel D–E (iliac crest, H&E): normocellular marrow (~50-60%) with interspersed fat and maturing trilineage hematopoiesis
Panel F (CD61 IHC): few scattered, non-clustered megakaryocytes
No overt fibrosis, sheets of blasts, or foreign (non-hematopoietic) tumor cells in the fields shown
66316.describe_en: The targeted T11 vertebral biopsy (panels A–C) shows a markedly hypercellular (near 100%) marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and a striking increase in large, hyperlobulated megakaryocytes forming loose clusters, highlighted by CD61 immunohistochemistry. Blasts are not conspicuously increased and no metastatic carcinoma or seminoma is seen. In contrast, the concurrent iliac crest biopsy (panels D–F) is normocellular with maturing trilineage hematopoiesis and scattered, non-clustered megakaryocytes. The vertebral lesion shows MPN-like morphology, while the staging marrow is unremarkable; together with a JAK2 V617F mutation at much higher VAF in the lesion, findings suggest a focal JAK2-mutated MPN-like process, with the systemic marrow best classified as clonal hematopoiesis.

ddx.vs: Systemic MPN shows the same megakaryocytic proliferation in the random iliac crest biopsy with abnormal blood counts, whereas here the iliac marrow is normocellular with non-clustered megakaryocytes and normal counts.

ddx.dx: Metastatic seminoma or other tumor to bone
ddx.vs: Metastasis forms cohesive sheets of non-hematopoietic cells replacing marrow, whereas the vertebral lesion consists of maturing trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Reactive megakaryocytic hyperplasia (e.g., near fracture or regenerating marrow)
ddx.vs: Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but normal-appearing, evenly dispersed and not tightly clustered or hyperlobulated, and lack a high-VAF JAK2 mutation.
EMH is usually a paravertebral soft-tissue mass in chronic hemolytic or myelofibrotic states and lacks the bony trabecular marrow context shown in panel A.

66060.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中出現與周圍造血細胞不同的黏聚性細胞團，細胞核圓至橢圓、染色質細緻、有小核仁，細胞質豐富淡藍紫色且彼此融合成合胞體樣（syncytial）團塊，細胞質中可見空泡；這種成團、非造血來源的細胞是轉移性癌侵犯骨髓的線索。
features: Cohesive clusters of large non-hematopoietic cells forming syncytial sheets with indistinct cell borders
Round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin, smooth contours and small nucleoli; mild nuclear overlapping
Abundant pale blue-violet cytoplasm with scattered clear vacuoles (possible mucin)
Left panel: large tumor aggregate; right panel: smaller cluster in a background of red cells and fat spaces
Paucity of normal hematopoietic precursors around the clusters
66060.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show cohesive clusters of large atypical cells with syncytial arrangement, round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, and abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm containing scattered vacuoles. These cells are clearly distinct from normal hematopoietic elements, which are sparse in the fields shown. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma involving the marrow (poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma with mucin production on the corresponding biopsy), accounting for myelophthisis.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts are loosely cohesive with eccentric nuclei, a distinct perinuclear hof away from the nucleus and do not form tight syncytial sheets with nuclear overlap.

Osteoclasts are single giant cells with many separate uniform nuclei within one cell membrane and granular pink cytoplasm, and megakaryocytes have one lobulated nucleus, whereas here many cells cluster with overlapping nuclei.
Lymphoma cells are generally discohesive, lack mucin vacuoles and express CD45/lymphoid markers rather than cytokeratin.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These occur mainly in children, have scant cytoplasm and form rosettes or small clusters, unlike the abundant vacuolated cytoplasm here.

66124.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一大團彼此緊貼、核相互擠壓（nuclear molding）的圓至卵圓形深染細胞，胞質僅為淡藍絲狀，團塊內與上方可見粉紅色纖維狀神經纖維網（neuropil），與周圍散在的造血細胞明顯不同，符合轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Large cohesive cluster of small-to-medium round-to-oval tumor cells with prominent nuclear molding
Hyperchromatic nuclei with finely granular chromatin and very high N:C ratio; nucleoli inconspicuous at this magnification
Scant wispy pale-blue cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Pink-violet fibrillary neuropil-like material within and adjacent to the cluster, with focal rosette-like arrangement around it
Background dispersed hematopoietic cells (lymphocytes, neutrophil) and red cells
66124.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cohesive cluster of non-hematopoietic small round blue cells with hyperchromatic, molded nuclei, scant wispy cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders. Pink fibrillary neuropil-like material is present within and at the edge of the cluster, with focal rosette-like arrangement of tumor cells around it, although a sharply circumscribed Homer-Wright rosette is not clearly delineated in this field. Scattered normal hematopoietic cells are present in the background. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by metastatic neuroblastoma.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are discohesive single cells without nuclear molding or neuropil and express TdT/CD19 or CD3 rather than PHOX2B/synaptophysin.
Ewing sarcoma forms clusters with vacuolated glycogen-rich cytoplasm and no neuropil, and is CD99/NKX2.2-positive with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells have more vacuolated cytoplasm, occasional multinucleated forms and express desmin/myogenin, without neuropil.
Small cell carcinoma shows similar molding and crush artifact but occurs in adults, lacks neuropil and is cytokeratin/TTF-1-positive.

64332.recognize_zh: 流式圖：先以 FSC-H/FSC-A 圈出單一細胞（singlets），再以 FSC/SSC 選出低側向散射的淋巴細胞；橘色 B 細胞群 CD5 陽性、CD10 陰性、CD20 亮陽性、CD38 表現不一，CD5+/CD10- 的 B 細胞需區分被套細胞淋巴瘤與 CLL。
features: FSC-A vs FSC-H singlet gate, followed by an FSC vs SSC gate on small low-SSC cells (orange)
CD5 vs CD10: orange population is CD5 positive and CD10 negative
Grey CD10-positive events (granulocytes) and blue CD5-positive T cells provide internal controls
CD20 vs CD38: orange B cells are CD20 bright with variable, predominantly dim to moderate CD38
Blue CD20-negative T/NK cells separated from the B-cell population
64332.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plots show doublet exclusion (FSC-A vs FSC-H) and a scatter gate on small cells with low side scatter. The orange-painted B-cell population co-expresses CD5, is negative for CD10, and shows bright CD20 with variable dim to moderate CD38. Internal controls include CD10-positive granulocytes and CD5-positive, CD20-negative T cells. A CD5-positive, CD10-negative, CD20-bright B-cell population favors mantle cell lymphoma over CLL, pending CD23, CD200, light chain and cyclin D1/CCND1 evaluation.

ddx.vs: CLL is CD5+ CD10- but has dim CD20 and is CD23 and CD200 positive.
FL is CD10 positive and CD5 negative.
MZL is typically CD5 and CD10 negative.
HCL shows high side scatter, bright CD11c, CD25, CD103 and CD123, and is usually CD5 negative.

65740.recognize_zh: 周邊血有許多大型母細胞，核質比高、染色質開放、核仁明顯；流式卻呈成熟 B 細胞表型（CD19+CD20+、表面 lambda 限制、CD34 與 TdT 陰性），核型見 11 號染色體異常且 FISH 顯示 KMT2A 3' 端缺失，是容易被誤判為成熟 B 細胞淋巴瘤的 KMT2A 重排 B-ALL。
features: Blood: numerous large blasts with high N:C ratio, open fine chromatin, prominent nucleoli and a rim of basophilic cytoplasm
CD45 vs SSC: large dim CD45, low side-scatter population (red)
Flow: CD19+/CD20+, surface lambda restricted, variable CD10, cytoplasmic CD79a+
Flow: CD34-negative, TdT-negative, CD64- and CD15-negative
Karyotype with multiple structural aberrations including chromosome 11 (arrows)
Metaphase FISH with KMT2A break-apart probe showing signal loss on the derivative chromosome 11
65740.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous large blasts with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed open chromatin, prominent nucleoli and scant basophilic cytoplasm. Flow cytometry shows a dim CD45, low side-scatter population expressing CD19, CD20, variable CD10, cytoplasmic CD79a and surface lambda light chain, but lacking CD34, TdT, CD64 and CD15. The karyotype is complex with a chromosome 11 aberration, and KMT2A break-apart FISH shows loss of the 3' signal on der(11), indicating KMT2A rearrangement. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with KMT2A rearrangement displaying a mature B-cell phenotype with surface light-chain restriction.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, bright CD10, a Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement, which was not detected.
Leukemic large B-cell lymphoma typically occurs in adults and carries MYC/BCL2/BCL6 rearrangements rather than KMT2A fusion in an infant.
Most B-ALL express CD34 and/or TdT and lack surface immunoglobulin; KMT2A-rearranged infant cases are usually CD10-negative/CD15-positive.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: KMT2A-rearranged AML shows monocytic blasts expressing CD64/CD14/CD15, all negative here, without B-cell antigens.

65676.recognize_zh: 同一腎臟切片的 CD5 染色：間質浸潤的小淋巴球普遍呈膜狀弱至中度棕色著色，少數細胞染色較強（可能為背景 T 細胞）；與 PAX5 陽性的同一片浸潤重疊，代表 B 細胞共同表現 CD5，支持 CLL/SLL。
features: Diffuse membranous CD5 staining throughout the dense interstitial lymphoid infiltrate
Weak to moderate staining in most cells, with scattered more intensely positive cells likely representing admixed T cells
Same distribution as the PAX5-positive infiltrate
Tubular epithelium and uninvolved parenchyma negative
65676.describe_en: CD5 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse membranous staining of the dense interstitial lymphoid infiltrate, generally weak to moderate in intensity, with scattered more strongly staining cells that likely represent admixed T cells. The distribution mirrors the PAX5-positive infiltrate, indicating aberrant CD5 expression on the neoplastic B cells. Tubules and adjacent parenchyma are negative. Together with PAX5, the findings support renal involvement by CLL/SLL; CD23 and LEF1 positivity with cyclin D1 negativity would further exclude mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: A reactive infiltrate would be CD5-positive but PAX5-negative, whereas here the CD5 staining coincides with the PAX5-positive B-cell sheet.
Mantle cell lymphoma is CD5-positive B-cell lymphoma distinguished by cyclin D1 and SOX11 positivity and CD23 negativity.
It is composed of large cells with a high Ki-67 index, unlike the small monotonous lymphocytes here.

65612.recognize_zh: 一顆分葉核嗜中性球的細胞質內有一顆圓形、均質深紫藍色、與核染色質同色的小包涵體，旁邊並有空泡；這種類似紅血球 Howell-Jolly body 的包涵體稱為 Howell-Jolly-like bodies，常與免疫抑制劑、化療或 HIV 相關。
features: Mature segmented neutrophil of normal size with clumped chromatin
Single small, round, homogeneous dark purple-blue cytoplasmic inclusion resembling a detached nuclear fragment
Adjacent clear cytoplasmic vacuole
Pale cytoplasm with sparse granulation
Background red cells show crenation/echinocytes; a platelet is present
65612.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil containing a single round, homogeneous, deeply basophilic cytoplasmic inclusion with staining identical to nuclear chromatin, adjacent to a small clear vacuole. The neutrophil cytoplasm is relatively hypogranular. Background red cells show crenation, likely artifactual. Findings are consistent with a Howell-Jolly-like body in a neutrophil, a nonspecific finding reported with immunosuppressive agents (e.g., tacrolimus, mycophenolate), chemotherapy, HIV infection and myelodysplasia.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale sky-blue, irregular, peripheral cytoplasmic patches rather than dense round chromatin-colored bodies.
Apoptotic cells show multiple dense pyknotic round fragments with hypereosinophilic cytoplasm and loss of lobation, rather than a single small body beside a normal lobed nucleus.
Morulae are stippled, mulberry-like clusters and bacteria are rod- or coccus-shaped and often multiple, unlike one homogeneous smooth sphere.
A platelet has granular pink-purple center with pale rim and lies out of the cell's focal plane, unlike a homogeneous intracytoplasmic basophilic body.

65548.recognize_zh: 肋膜液抹片中成群的大型細胞，核偏心、染色質呈粗塊狀、細胞質豐富且深藍、部分可見核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），是非典型漿細胞；出現在體液中代表骨髓瘤髓外侵犯。
features: Numerous large atypical plasma cells, many 2-3 times the size of adjacent red cells
Eccentric round nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin and occasional small visible nucleoli
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof in some cells
Irregular, frayed cytoplasmic borders with small blebs
Background of red cells without significant reactive mesothelial or inflammatory cells in this field
65548.describe_en: Pleural fluid cytospin shows numerous large atypical plasma cells. The cells have eccentrically placed round nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, several with a perinuclear hof and irregular cytoplasmic borders. Reactive mesothelial cells and inflammatory cells are not prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with pleural involvement by plasma cell myeloma (myelomatous pleural effusion); confirmation by flow cytometry or CD138 and light chain studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells have central nuclei, a two-toned cytoplasm with peripheral skirt/windows, and cluster together, rather than eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof.
Reactive plasma cells are fewer, smaller, and mature with polytypic light chains, whereas these are numerous, large, and atypical.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or large B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: These show more blastic chromatin, prominent central nucleoli, and high proliferation, and require clinical and immunophenotypic correlation (CD20, EBER, MYC) to separate.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive three-dimensional clusters with nuclear molding and are keratin positive, CD138/light chain restricted plasma cells are not.

65484.recognize_zh: 視野中三顆大型細胞，細胞質豐富、呈灰藍色毛玻璃樣，核圓到腎形並有淺摺痕，染色質細緻開放；沒有粗顆粒也沒有 Auer rod。這種灰藍細胞質加上摺疊、細緻染色質的核，是前單核球的樣子，指向急性單核球性白血病。
features: Three large cells with abundant grey-blue, ground-glass cytoplasm
Round to reniform nuclei with shallow folds or a notch
Finely dispersed, delicate chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
No coarse azurophilic granules or Auer rods
Background red cells normochromic with a few crenated forms; no mature neutrophils in this field
65484.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three large circulating cells with abundant grey-blue ground-glass cytoplasm and round to reniform, gently folded nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin. Coarse granules and Auer rods are not seen. These morphologic features correspond to promonocytes, which are counted as blast equivalents. Findings are consistent with acute monocytic leukemia; cytochemistry (NSE) and flow cytometry are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Mature monocytes show more condensed, clumped chromatin and more vacuolated cytoplasm, without the delicate immature chromatin.
AMML contains a significant population (≥20%) of neutrophil-lineage cells and MPO-positive myeloblasts in addition to monocytic cells.
M3v cells show deeply cleft bilobed nuclei and strong MPO positivity with dusty granules.
Hairy cells are smaller with circumferential hair-like projections, oval nuclei and a CD11c/CD25/CD103/annexin A1 B-cell phenotype.

65228.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞內與周圍有成群的小卵圓形酵母，每顆有透明暈圈，一側有深藍色月牙形核（crescent），大小一致約 2–4 µm；這種「透明暈圈加月牙核」的細胞內小酵母是莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）的典型表現。
features: Clusters of small, uniform, oval yeast forms (about 2-4 um) within a macrophage and free in the background
Each yeast with a clear unstained halo and an eccentric crescent-shaped basophilic nucleus
Macrophage with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm hosting the organisms
Surrounding hematopoietic and stromal cells with large nuclei in a thick area of smear
Yellow-brown refractile ring-like material in the background, likely hemosiderin or precipitate
65228.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a thick cellular area with macrophages and hematopoietic cells. Numerous small, uniform, oval yeast forms with a clear halo and an eccentric crescentic nucleus are present both within macrophage cytoplasm and extracellularly. Yellow-brown refractile material in the background likely represents hemosiderin or stain precipitate. The findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by Histoplasma capsulatum.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes show a round nucleus plus a separate bar-shaped kinetoplast without a clear halo.
Talaromyces yeasts show a central transverse septum from binary fission and elongated forms rather than budding with a crescent nucleus.
C. glabrata yeasts are slightly larger, lack the halo-and-crescent appearance, and are rarely seen within marrow macrophages.
Platelets have purple granular centers without a clear halo or crescent nucleus and are variable in size.

65164.recognize_zh: 這是血液分析儀的紅血球體積分布直方圖，依住院日（HD #3–#18）排列：早期曲線為單峰、左側低體積端尾巴略抬高（碎裂紅血球造成的小體積顆粒），之後右側逐漸出現肩峰與拖尾並使曲線變寬，代表大體積的網狀紅血球族群出現，對應 TTP 溶血後的骨髓代償。
features: Serial impedance RBC volume histograms from hospital days 3 to 18, each with volume (fL) on the x-axis
Early histograms (HD 3-7): single relatively narrow peak with a slightly raised left tail in the low-volume region, consistent with small fragments/schistocytes
From about HD 9-10 onward: progressive right-sided shoulder and tail indicating an emerging macrocytic population
Later histograms (HD 12-18): broadened, right-skewed distribution reflecting increased RDW and MCV from reticulocytosis
Solid and dotted vertical gating lines mark distribution limits and the 60 fL/120 fL thresholds
65164.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic figure showing serial impedance RBC volume histograms from a patient with thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura. Early tracings show a single peak with a mildly elevated left, low-volume tail, attributable to schistocytes and red cell fragments. Over subsequent hospital days a right-sided shoulder and tail emerge and the curve broadens, indicating a second, larger-volume population consistent with reticulocytes during recovery from hemolysis. The changes correspond to rising MCV and RDW and illustrate how histogram review adds information beyond the numeric indices; smear review remains necessary to confirm schistocytes.

ddx.dx: Platelet clumps or giant platelets interfering with the RBC channel
ddx.vs: Platelet interference also elevates the low-volume region but is confirmed by smear showing platelet aggregates rather than schistocytes and by a spuriously low platelet count.

Transfusion creates a normocytic donor peak superimposed on the patient's own population, whereas reticulocytosis produces a progressive right-sided macrocytic shoulder that coincides with a rising reticulocyte count.
RBC agglutinates produce a spurious high-volume tail with falsely high MCV and low RBC count that corrects on warming the sample.

65100.recognize_zh: 20 倍骨髓切片中造血組織被流水狀梭形細胞與疏鬆膠原基質取代，其間可見多顆巨核細胞（部分核深染、形狀不規則），殘存的造血細胞稀疏，符合 TAFRO 症候群的骨髓纖維化。
features: Marrow space replaced by streaming spindle cells in a loose collagenous and edematous stroma
Scattered megakaryocytes, including small forms with hyperchromatic, irregular or lobulated nuclei
Sparse residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors
Scattered small adipocytes and dilated thin-walled vessels
No cohesive epithelial nests or atypical lymphoid infiltrate in this field
65100.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at 20x shows the hematopoietic space extensively replaced by streaming spindle cells in a loose collagenous, focally edematous stroma. Megakaryocytes are readily seen, some small with hyperchromatic, irregular nuclei, while residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors are sparse. There are no cohesive tumor nests or atypical lymphoid aggregates. Findings are consistent with marrow fibrosis with megakaryocytic proliferation, as described in TAFRO syndrome; reticulin and trichrome staining and exclusion of a myeloid neoplasm are required.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes are large, bizarre and tightly clustered with cloud-like nuclei, accompanied by osteosclerosis, intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis and a driver mutation (JAK2/CALR/MPL).

ddx.dx: Acute panmyelosis with myelofibrosis / AML with fibrosis
ddx.vs: These show increased CD34-positive blasts within the fibrotic marrow, which should be sought by CD34 immunostaining and is not expected in TAFRO.
MDS with fibrosis shows small hypolobated dysplastic megakaryocytes with multilineage dysplasia on the aspirate and clonal cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities.

65036.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結內一條粗大、玻璃樣變的膠原纖維帶（粉紅色、細胞稀少）伸入皮質下區，緊鄰上方一個大型反應性濾泡，生發中心含可染體巨噬細胞並有完整套區，呈纖維化合併濾泡增生的發炎性偽瘤樣變化。
features: Broad band of dense, hypocellular, hyalinized collagen extending into the subcortical region
Thin strands of fibrosis radiating from the collagen band into surrounding lymphoid tissue
Adjacent large reactive secondary follicle with a well-defined mantle zone
Germinal center containing scattered tingible body macrophages (starry pattern)
Surrounding paracortex with mixed small lymphocytes and prominent small vessels
65036.describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows a broad band of dense, hypocellular hyalinized collagen extending into the subcortical area, with thinner fibrous strands radiating into the adjacent lymphoid tissue. A large reactive secondary follicle lies next to the fibrotic focus, with a well-formed mantle zone and a germinal center containing tingible body macrophages. The surrounding paracortex contains mixed small lymphocytes and small vessels without an atypical infiltrate. Findings are consistent with the fibrosclerotic pattern of nodal inflammatory pseudotumor with associated reactive follicular hyperplasia.

ddx.vs: NSCHL shows collagen bands encircling nodules that contain lacunar and Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+, CD15+, PAX5 dim), which must be excluded by searching for these cells and immunostaining.
IgG4-related disease has storiform fibrosis with obliterative phlebitis and IgG4+ plasma cells >100/HPF with IgG4/IgG ratio >40%, whereas IgG4+ cells were only mildly increased in this case.

IMT forms a mass of fascicular myofibroblasts with frequent ALK rearrangement and ALK immunopositivity, whereas nodal inflammatory pseudotumor is a reactive, usually ALK-negative, capsule-and-trabecula-based process.

64780.recognize_zh: 四格影像中箭頭所指的嗜中性球，細胞質內吞入一顆均質、淡紫紅色、無染色質結構的圓形 LE 小體（LE body），把分葉核擠到邊緣呈新月形，即 LE 細胞（LE cell）。
features: Neutrophils containing a large, round, homogeneous, glassy magenta-purple intracytoplasmic inclusion (LE body) lacking chromatin texture
Host neutrophil nucleus compressed and displaced to the periphery, forming a crescent around the ingested material
Engulfed body occupies most of the cell volume, larger than the host nucleus in several cells
Panel D shows a cluster of neutrophils around homogeneous nuclear material (rosette-like arrangement)
Background of mature neutrophils, lymphocytes and erythrocytes without blasts
64780.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (panels A-D) show several neutrophils that have phagocytosed a single large, round, smooth, homogeneous purple-magenta inclusion devoid of chromatin pattern, with the host lobulated nucleus pushed to the periphery as a crescent. Panel D shows a small cluster of neutrophils aggregated around similar denatured nuclear material. No blasts or significant dysplasia are evident in these fields. The findings represent lupus erythematosus (LE) cells and are suggestive of systemic lupus erythematosus; correlation with ANA, anti-dsDNA and complement levels is recommended.

ddx.vs: In a tart cell (usually a monocyte/macrophage) the ingested nucleus retains visible chromatin structure and a nuclear outline, whereas the LE body is homogeneous and structureless.
Hemophagocytosis is performed by large macrophages ingesting intact erythrocytes, platelets or whole cells, not by neutrophils containing a single smooth homogeneous nuclear mass.

ddx.dx: Neutrophil phagocytosing apoptotic cell or ingested bacteria/fungi
ddx.vs: Apoptotic bodies are dense pyknotic fragments and organisms are small and uniform, unlike the single large glassy LE body.

ddx.dx: Binucleate or giant neutrophil / artifact overlap
ddx.vs: Overlapping cells show two separate cell membranes and chromatin texture, whereas the LE body lies within the neutrophil cytoplasm and indents its nucleus.

64268.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一個比紅血球大約兩倍的原始細胞，核圓、染色質細緻均勻、核質比高，外圍一圈深藍嗜鹼性細胞質且無顆粒；單看此細胞只能判定為原始細胞，無法單憑型態確定其系別。
features: Single circulating blast roughly twice the diameter of adjacent erythrocytes
High N:C ratio with a round central nucleus
Finely dispersed, homogeneous chromatin; nucleoli indistinct at this resolution
Narrow rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm without Auer rods or blebs
Background erythrocytes largely normochromic; no nucleated red cells or other leukocytes in the field
64268.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating blast with a high N:C ratio, a round nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin, and a thin rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods, granules or cytoplasmic blebs are identified, and nucleoli are not well resolved. The background red cells show no specific abnormality in this field. The cell is a blast of indeterminate lineage by morphology alone; in the context of pure erythroid leukemia, the deep basophilia is compatible with a circulating proerythroblast, but lineage should be established by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts may look identical, requiring flow cytometry showing CD19/CD79a or cCD3 versus erythroid markers such as CD71/CD235a.
Myeloblasts typically have less basophilic cytoplasm, more prominent nucleoli and may contain azurophilic granules or Auer rods, and are MPO positive.
Immunoblasts have more abundant cytoplasm, coarser chromatin with a prominent central nucleolus and occur among a spectrum of reactive lymphocytes.
Megakaryoblasts often show cytoplasmic blebs and are CD41/CD61 positive, which morphology of a single cell cannot exclude.

64588.recognize_zh: 一顆大型、核分葉、細胞質豐富的巨核細胞，其細胞質內可見數顆完整的嗜中性球與帶狀核（band）細胞，被包在細胞質中而非被消化，是巨核細胞的 emperipolesis；周圍有許多核偏位、細胞質深藍的漿細胞。
features: Large megakaryocyte with a lobulated nucleus and abundant granular blue-gray cytoplasm
Several intact granulocytes (segmented neutrophils and bands) lying within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm, each in a pale halo
Engulfed cells retain normal nuclear segmentation and chromatin, without signs of degradation
Megakaryocyte surrounded by numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs, some with visible nucleoli
Scattered neutrophils and red cells in the background
64588.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with a lobulated nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm containing several intact segmented and band neutrophils, each surrounded by a thin pale halo and lacking features of degradation. The megakaryocyte is surrounded by numerous plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs, some with visible nucleoli, in keeping with the patient's known plasma cell neoplasm. Findings represent megakaryocytic emperipolesis, an incidental finding that should not be mistaken for hemophagocytosis.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytes are mononuclear macrophages whose phagosomes contain degraded red cells, platelets or nuclear debris, whereas here intact viable neutrophils lie within a multilobated megakaryocyte.
Overlapping cells lie in a different focal plane without the pale emperisome halo, whereas true emperipolesis shows cells embedded within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm.
Cannibalism is performed by atypical nonhematopoietic or neoplastic cells, not by a recognizable megakaryocyte with lobulated nucleus and platelet-type granular cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Increased emperipolesis in MPN or gray platelet syndrome
ddx.vs: The morphology is identical; recognizing increased frequency with atypical megakaryocytes or agranular platelets depends on the broader marrow and blood findings rather than a single cell.

64460.recognize_zh: 結腸隱窩結構大致保留，但固有層被中型至大型、染色質較開放的異型淋巴細胞密集擴張，隱窩並未被破壞；CD56 免疫染色瀰漫強陽性，提示 NK 細胞來源的增生。
features: Colonic mucosa with preserved crypt architecture and intact surface epithelium (panel A)
Dense, band-like infiltrate expanding the lamina propria between crypts
Medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular nuclei, open chromatin and moderate pale to amphophilic cytoplasm (panel B)
No conspicuous epitheliotropism or crypt destruction at this magnification
Diffuse strong membranous CD56 positivity of the infiltrate (panel C)
Paranuclear cytoplasmic granules are not clearly resolved at this image resolution
64460.describe_en: Sections of a colonic polyp show mucosa with preserved crypts overlying a dense lymphoid infiltrate that expands the lamina propria. The infiltrate is composed of medium to large atypical cells with irregular nuclei, open chromatin and moderate pale cytoplasm; epitheliotropism, crypt destruction and angiodestructive necrosis are not evident in these fields. CD56 immunostain is diffusely and strongly positive. Together with CD3+ (cytoplasmic), CD5-, TCR-negative, cytotoxic granule-positive, EBER-negative phenotype, no clonal TCR rearrangement and an indolent course, findings are consistent with indolent NK-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

ddx.vs: ENKTL shows angiocentric/angiodestructive growth with necrosis and is EBER-positive by ISH, whereas this lesion is EBER-negative without necrosis.
MEITL shows monomorphic cells with marked epitheliotropism, CD8+ and TCRγδ (or αβ) expression with clonal TCR rearrangement, all absent here.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: The indolent T-cell disorder consists of small, bland, CD4+ or CD8+ T cells with surface CD3 and clonal TCR rearrangement, unlike these larger CD56+ NK cells.

ddx.dx: Poorly differentiated carcinoma or neuroendocrine tumor
ddx.vs: Carcinoma and neuroendocrine neoplasms are cytokeratin-positive and form cohesive nests, whereas these discohesive cells are CD2/CD3/CD56-positive lymphoid cells.

64396.recognize_zh: 未染色的毛髮光學顯微鏡下，毛幹中央（髓質）可見大型、不規則且分布不均的黑褐色黑色素團塊，而非正常細小均勻的色素顆粒，是 Griscelli 症候群的典型毛髮表現。
features: Hair shafts examined by light microscopy, unstained
Large, irregular dark brown-black melanin clumps aligned mainly along the central (medullary) axis
Uneven, discontinuous distribution of pigment aggregates along the shaft (arrows)
Remaining cortex shows relatively sparse, fine pigment
No structural shaft abnormality such as twisting or nodes identified
64396.describe_en: Light microscopic examination of unstained hair shafts shows large, irregular aggregates of melanin pigment clustered unevenly along the central axis of the shaft, with intervening areas of relatively pale cortex. The pigment clumps are considerably larger than the fine, evenly dispersed granules of normal hair, and no shaft structural defects are seen. These findings are consistent with the pigmentary hair abnormality of Griscelli syndrome; genetic testing (RAB27A, MYO5A, MLPH) and evaluation for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis are recommended.

ddx.vs: Chediak-Higashi hair shows small, regularly spaced pigment granules, and blood leukocytes contain giant granules, which are absent in Griscelli syndrome.
Elejalde syndrome shows similar large irregular melanin clumps but is dominated by severe neurologic dysfunction without HLH; genetic overlap with Griscelli type 1 is debated.
Normal hair contains fine melanin granules distributed evenly throughout the cortex without large medullary clumps.
Albinism shows reduced or absent pigment without large clumped aggregates.

64140.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高，骨小樑旁與間質中巨核細胞數量增加，且多數核為圓形或僅輕度分葉的小核（non-lobated/hypolobated），而非正常的多分葉核，符合 del(5q) MDS。
features: Hypercellular marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula with reduced fat
Increased megakaryocytes, scattered and in loose groups, including paratrabecular locations
Megakaryocyte nuclei predominantly round, non-lobated or hypolobated
Megakaryocytes of normal to slightly small size with moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Background of maturing myeloid and erythroid elements without obvious blast sheets at this power
64140.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with a reduced proportion of fat adjacent to a bony trabecula. Megakaryocytes are increased and scattered singly and in loose groups, with a predominance of forms with round non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm. The background shows trilineage hematopoiesis without obvious sheets of immature cells at this magnification. Findings are consistent with the megakaryocytic dysplasia typical of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q), which requires karyotype or FISH confirmation and blast enumeration on aspirate and CD34 immunostaining.

ddx.vs: ET shows large to giant megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei in a normocellular marrow, not non-lobated forms.
PMF megakaryocytes form dense clusters with bulbous, cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei and are accompanied by reticulin fibrosis.

ddx.dx: MDS with other cytogenetics (micromegakaryocytes, separated lobes)
ddx.vs: Other MDS show micromegakaryocytes or widely separated nuclear lobes rather than predominantly normal-sized monolobated megakaryocytes; cytogenetics resolves the category.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but retain normal nuclear lobation, with no dysplasia in other lineages.

64012.recognize_zh: 這是非形態學的 G 顯帶核型圖：9 號與 22 號染色體旁有箭頭標示 t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)，22 號位置有多條小型衍生 22 號（費城染色體，der(22) ×3），整體為近三倍體（60<3n>）且伴多條染色體數目異常，38/40 個細胞異常。
features: GTG-banded karyogram at 400-band resolution; 40 metaphases screened and karyotyped
Arrows mark the derivative chromosome 9 and derivative 22 (Philadelphia chromosome) of t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)
Three copies of der(22)t(9;22) (three small arrowed chromosomes in the 22 position)
Two normal metaphases: 46,XY[02]
64012.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic G-banded karyotype analysis at 400-band resolution. Thirty-eight of 40 metaphases show a near-triploid clone with 60 chromosomes relative to a triploid baseline, loss of Y and multiple whole-chromosome losses (1, 2, 4, 5, 9, 11, 13, 16, 17, 18, 20), gain of chromosome 15, and a t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) with three copies of the derivative 22 (Philadelphia chromosome); two metaphases are normal 46,XY. The multiple Ph copies and complex hyperdiploid/near-triploid karyotype indicate clonal evolution. In the context of acute myeloid leukemia, findings support AML with BCR::ABL1, but BCR::ABL1 fusion should be confirmed by FISH or RT-PCR (including transcript type), and myeloid blast phase of CML must be excluded clinically and morphologically.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in myeloid blast phase
ddx.vs: Blast phase CML shows the same t(9;22), often with extra Ph copies, but has a prior chronic phase, splenomegaly, basophilia, and BCR::ABL1 p210 transcript, which distinguish it from de novo AML with BCR::ABL1.
B-ALL with Ph is separated by immunophenotype (CD19/CD10/cytoplasmic CD79a) and often carries the p190 transcript.

ddx.dx: Mixed phenotype acute leukemia with BCR::ABL1
ddx.vs: MPAL requires flow cytometric evidence of both myeloid (MPO) and lymphoid lineage-specific markers on the blasts.

ddx.dx: Complex karyotype AML (AML-MR) without true BCR::ABL1
ddx.vs: A variant rearrangement mimicking 22q11 loss would lack a BCR::ABL1 fusion signal on FISH or RT-PCR.

64076.recognize_zh: 流式細胞散佈圖（CD45dim 閘門）顯示這群細胞 cytoplasmic CD3 與 CD7 強陽性，但 CD4、CD8、CD1a 皆陰性，CD5 弱，並表現 CD13/CD33 與部分 CD56、CD10；確立 T 淋巴母細胞系，且 CD1a−/CD8−/CD5 弱加骨髓系標記的組合要想到 early T-precursor（ETP）表型。
features: Seven flow cytometry dot plots gated on CD45-dim events
Cytoplasmic CD3 and CD7 positive (bright CD7), establishing T lineage
CD4 and CD8 double negative; CD1a negative; HLA-DR negative
Dim-to-partial CD5 and partial CD10 expression
CD13 positive and weak CD33 expression; CD56 positive on a subset with a heterogeneous smear
Non-morphologic image; CD34, CD117, and surface CD3 are stated negative but not plotted
64076.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plots gated on CD45-dim events show an abnormal population expressing cytoplasmic CD3 and bright CD7, with dim/partial CD5, partial CD10, CD13, weak CD33, and a CD56-positive subset. The population is negative for CD4, CD8, CD1a, and HLA-DR, and per the report lacks surface CD3, CD34, and CD117. Cytoplasmic CD3 with CD7 establishes T-lineage commitment, and the immature phenotype supports T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma in the appropriate setting (TdT status not shown). The CD1a-negative, CD8-negative, CD5-dim profile with myeloid antigen expression raises the possibility of an early T-precursor (ETP) immunophenotype, and exclusion of mixed-phenotype acute leukemia requires MPO assessment.

ddx.vs: MPAL T/myeloid requires MPO positivity (or monocytic differentiation) in addition to cytoplasmic CD3, whereas CD13/CD33 alone are insufficient to assign myeloid lineage.
AML may express CD7 and CD56 but lacks strong cytoplasmic CD3 and is usually MPO-positive or shows CD34/CD117 expression.
Mature T-cell lymphomas express surface CD3 and usually CD4 or CD8 without TdT or CD10, and NK neoplasms lack cytoplasmic CD3 epsilon by most flow clones.
Cortical T-ALL is CD1a-positive and often CD4/CD8 double positive, unlike this CD1a-negative double-negative population.

63820.recognize_zh: 整個視野的紅血球之間密密麻麻散布大量血小板，且大小差異明顯，可見與紅血球等大的巨大血小板（giant platelets）與顆粒較少的大血小板；這種極度血小板增多合併巨大血小板、而白血球與紅血球形態大致正常，符合原發性血小板增多症（essential thrombocythemia）。
features: Marked thrombocytosis with platelets densely scattered across the field
Platelet anisocytosis with large and giant platelets approaching red cell size
Some giant platelets appear hypogranular or with clustered central granules
A single vacuolated mononuclear cell with an irregular nucleus, most consistent with a monocyte
Red cells largely normocytic with drying-artifact refractile central pallor; no nucleated red cells, blasts or teardrop cells evident
63820.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked increase in platelets with pronounced platelet anisocytosis, including large and giant forms, some hypogranular. Red cells are largely normocytic and normochromic without significant teardrop cells or nucleated red cells, and a single vacuolated monocyte is present; no blasts or immature granulocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm with marked thrombocytosis such as essential thrombocythemia, to be confirmed by bone marrow morphology and JAK2, CALR or MPL mutation testing with exclusion of BCR::ABL1.

ddx.vs: Reactive thrombocytosis rarely exceeds 1000 x 10^9/L, has small uniform platelets and a clear cause (iron deficiency, inflammation, splenectomy), without JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations.
CML shows leukocytosis with a myelocyte peak and basophilia and is BCR::ABL1 positive, whereas ET has normal leukocyte differentiation.
Prefibrotic PMF may mimic ET in blood but shows leukoerythroblastosis, raised LDH and marrow granulocytic proliferation with atypical clustered megakaryocytes having hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: This entity shows dyserythropoiesis with ≥15% ring sideroblasts and SF3B1 mutation, often with macrocytic anemia, unlike ET.

63756.recognize_zh: 這張多格組圖可以看到大量形態不一的原始細胞：有小而核質比高的 L1 樣、較大的 L2 樣、手鏡形（hand-mirror）與單核球樣原始細胞，加上含 Auer 小體的細胞、破碎的污跡細胞與標靶紅血球；形態混雜提示需要流式確認的混合表型急性白血病（MPAL）。
features: Heterogeneous blasts: small high N:C L1-like blasts, larger L2-like blasts and hand-mirror forms
Monocytoid blasts with folded nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm, some vacuolated or granular
Cell containing Auer rods (panel C, labelled 8) indicating myeloid differentiation
Large smudged/broken cells with fibrillar pink chromatin (Gumprecht-like shadows)
Target cells and a circulating nucleated red cell in the background; no sickle cells seen
Marrow panel F with dysplastic granulocytic precursors (pseudo-Pelger forms) among blasts
63756.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (panels A–E) shows marked leukocytosis with numerous blasts of heterogeneous morphology, including small blasts with scant cytoplasm (L1-like), larger blasts with more cytoplasm (L2-like), hand-mirror forms and monocytoid blasts with folded nuclei and occasionally vacuolated or granular cytoplasm. A cell with Auer rods is present, and there are numerous large smudged cells with fibrillar nuclear material. The red cells include target cells and an occasional nucleated red cell; sickle cells are not identified. The bone marrow aspirate (panel F) shows blasts with dysplastic granulocytic forms. The heterogeneous blast morphology is not lineage-specific; with flow cytometry showing MPO plus T-lineage (cyCD3) and B-lineage (CD19, cyCD22, CD79a) antigens, findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia (B/T/myeloid).

ddx.vs: Auer rods and monocytoid blasts fit AML, but MPAL is defined only by flow showing coexisting cyCD3 and strong B-lineage antigens beyond aberrant expression.

ddx.dx: T-lymphoblastic leukemia with myeloid antigen expression
ddx.vs: T-ALL may express CD13/CD33/CD117 but lacks MPO and Auer rods and does not carry strong CD19 with cyCD22/CD79a.
ETP-ALL is cyCD3+, CD1a-/CD8-, with stem/myeloid markers but MPO negative, whereas this case is CD1a+ and MPO+.
CLL smudge cells occur among uniform mature small lymphocytes, not with blasts and Auer rods.

63692.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的大細胞內沒有核膜，兩團濃縮、呈絲狀的染色體分別位於細胞兩極，中間隔著淡色區域，細胞質仍連成一體尚未分裂，符合有絲分裂後期（anaphase）。
features: Large cell with two separate clusters of condensed, spiky chromosomes at opposite poles
No nuclear membrane; clear cytoplasmic zone between the two chromosome sets
Single continuous cytoplasm without a cleavage furrow
Pale gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, suggesting a granulocytic precursor
Cellular background with myeloid precursors, erythroblasts, and disrupted smudged cells
63692.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with a mixture of granulocytic and erythroid precursors and occasional disrupted cells. The arrowed cell contains two separate aggregates of condensed chromosomes at opposite poles within a single, undivided cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, without a nuclear membrane or cleavage furrow. This is a mitotic figure in anaphase, most likely in a granulocytic precursor. No multipolar figure or lagging chromosomes are seen. Findings are consistent with a normal anaphase mitotic figure.

ddx.vs: A binucleate cell has two intact nuclei with nuclear membranes and a regular chromatin pattern rather than naked condensed chromosome clusters.
Telophase shows a cleavage furrow and reforming rounded daughter nuclei, which are absent here.
A multipolar mitosis shows three or more chromosome groups or lagging chromosomes rather than two symmetric poles.
Apoptotic nuclear fragments are smooth, round, and homogeneously dense instead of filamentous chromosome arms.

63500.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片可見一顆細長鐮刀細胞與數顆船形（boat-shaped）紅血球，並有多顆標靶細胞、三顆有核紅血球，許多紅血球內有細小深色的 Pappenheimer 小體，符合鐮刀型細胞/β0 地中海貧血並伴功能性脾臟低下。
features: Marked anisopoikilocytosis with target cells and boat-shaped (oat) cells
An elongated sickle cell with tapered ends
Three nucleated red blood cells with dense pyknotic nuclei
Many red cells containing small basophilic peripheral inclusions (Pappenheimer bodies)
Hypochromic/microcytic tendency with folded and irregularly contracted cells
Platelets present in normal-appearing numbers
63500.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with numerous target cells, boat-shaped cells, folded cells, and an elongated sickle cell. Three nucleated red blood cells are present, and many red cells contain small, peripheral basophilic inclusions consistent with Pappenheimer bodies, reflecting hyposplenism. Platelets are adequate and no leukocyte abnormalities are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a sickling disorder with thalassemic features, supporting sickle cell/β0-thalassemia; hemoglobin analysis showing HbS without HbA and with increased HbA2 is needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HbSS usually has normocytic indices with fewer target cells, and it is separated from HbS/β0-thalassemia by microcytosis, increased HbA2, and family studies rather than by the smear alone.
HbSC shows angular SC poikilocytes and HbC crystals with abundant target cells, and electrophoresis shows HbC.
Basophilic stippling is fine and diffusely distributed throughout the cell, whereas Pappenheimer bodies are few coarse clustered granules at the periphery that stain with Prussian blue.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single, larger, round dense nuclear remnants rather than clusters of small iron-containing granules.

63308.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆大型組織球，淡灰藍色胞質內含三顆圓形深染的小細胞核（被吞噬的有核細胞），呈「一袋細胞」（bag of cells）樣，代表噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）；需搭配臨床與 HLH-2004 準則判讀。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm and indistinct cell border in the center of the field
Several small, round, dense pyknotic nuclei (engulfed nucleated hematopoietic cells) within the histiocyte cytoplasm
Surrounding mixed marrow cells including myeloid precursors, lymphocytes and small dark erythroblasts
Background of lysed, ghost-like red cells and smeared cytoplasmic debris
63308.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (MGG) shows a large histiocyte with abundant pale cytoplasm containing several engulfed, small, round, darkly staining nuclei consistent with ingested hematopoietic mononuclear cells, giving a 'bag of cells' appearance. Discrete intact ingested red cells are not clearly resolved in this field. The surrounding marrow shows a mixture of myeloid precursors, lymphocytes and erythroid cells in a background of lysed red cells. There are no abnormal blasts or organisms identified in this field. Findings demonstrate hemophagocytosis, which in the reported setting of septicemia supports secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis when clinical and laboratory criteria are met.

ddx.dx: Reactive macrophage with apoptotic debris (tingible body macrophage)
ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain irregular fragmented nuclear debris rather than intact whole cells with preserved round nuclei.
In a nurse cell, erythroblasts cluster around the outside of the central macrophage rather than lying within its cytoplasmic vacuoles.
Neoplastic histiocytes show marked nuclear atypia and pleomorphism, whereas hemophagocytic histiocytes in HLH have bland nuclei.
True phagocytosis shows cells enclosed within the histiocyte cytoplasm, often with a surrounding clear phagosome halo, rather than cells lying on top in a different focal plane.

63244.recognize_zh: 周邊血組圖中的異常前骨髓細胞，細胞質佈滿嗜天青顆粒或顆粒偏少，核呈腎形或雙葉（蝴蝶形）；部分細胞質內可見寬扁、長方形或棒狀、淡粉紅色的類結晶包涵體，比 Auer 小體更粗、顏色更淡且邊緣平直；配合 CD34-/HLA-DR- 的免疫表型，符合急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）中少見的結晶樣包涵體。
features: Abnormal promyelocytes with high to moderate N:C ratio, reniform or bilobed ('butterfly') nuclei and fine chromatin
Cytoplasm heavily packed with azurophilic granules in some cells; hypogranular cytoplasm in others
Distinct broad, rectangular to rod-shaped, pale pink crystal-like cytoplasmic inclusions, single or multiple, some arranged in a radiating pattern
Inclusions are wider, paler and more sharply angular than typical Auer rods
A mature segmented neutrophil present for comparison; background red cells without other significant abnormality
63244.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear images show a population of abnormal promyelocytes with reniform to bilobed nuclei, fine chromatin and either heavily granulated or hypogranular cytoplasm. Several cells contain unusual broad, rectangular to rod-shaped, pale pink crystal-like cytoplasmic inclusions, single or multiple and occasionally radiating, which are wider and paler than conventional Auer rods. A mature neutrophil is present for comparison. The nature of the inclusions cannot be determined morphologically. In conjunction with an MPO-positive, CD33+/CD13+, CD34-/HLA-DR-/CD117- immunophenotype, the findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia with unusual crystalline cytoplasmic inclusions; confirmation of PML::RARA is urgent.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with maturation (with Auer rods)
ddx.vs: AML with maturation shows blasts with thin needle-like Auer rods, CD34/HLA-DR expression and no bilobed hypergranular promyelocytes or PML::RARA fusion.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are elongated bipyramidal hexagonal crystals derived from eosinophils/basophils, found extracellularly or in macrophages rather than within leukemic promyelocytes.
Pseudo-Chediak-Higashi inclusions are large round azurophilic granules, not angular rectangular crystals.
The microgranular variant shows bilobed hypogranular cells with high WBC; it is part of the same entity and is separated only by the granule pattern, not by the presence of crystals.

63116.recognize_zh: 小而淡染的紅血球中有明顯標靶細胞，中央可見一顆典型兩端尖的鐮刀細胞，另有少數體積較大、略帶藍灰的多染性紅血球，符合鐮刀型 β 地中海型貧血。
features: Microcytic, hypochromic red cells with anisocytosis
Frequent target cells
Occasional sickle cells with tapered ends (center and top of field)
Scattered larger, slightly grey-blue polychromatophilic cells
Normal segmented neutrophil and scattered platelets
63116.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows microcytic, hypochromic red cells with anisocytosis, frequent target cells, and occasional sickle cells with tapered ends. A few larger polychromatophilic cells are present, consistent with reticulocyte response. The neutrophil and platelets appear morphologically normal. Recent transfusion may dilute the abnormal red cell population. Findings are suggestive of sickle β-thalassemia, confirmed here by mutation analysis.

ddx.vs: HbSS usually has normocytic indices with more numerous sickle cells and Howell-Jolly bodies from autosplenectomy, whereas microcytosis with hypochromia favors Sβ-thalassemia; HPLC (HbA2 elevated, HbA absent/reduced) and molecular testing separate them.
HbSC shows many target cells and characteristic HbC crystals and folded/boat-shaped cells, with fewer classic sickle cells and HbC on HPLC.
β-thalassemia shows microcytosis, target cells, and nucleated red cells but no sickle cells, and HbS is absent on HPLC.
Iron deficiency has microcytic hypochromic cells and pencil cells but lacks sickle cells and prominent target cells, with low ferritin.

63052.recognize_zh: A 圖的嗜中性球體積不大，但核分成六葉以上、緊密堆疊呈花瓣狀（hypersegmentation）；B 圖則是細胞質偏藍、核呈多個濃縮小葉的顆粒球，背景紅血球大致正常，出現在 COVID-19 感染的周邊血液。
features: Panel A: neutrophil with markedly hypersegmented nucleus (six or more small, compact lobes) and pale granular cytoplasm
Panel B: granulocyte with more basophilic cytoplasm and multiple condensed, clustered nuclear lobes
Nuclear lobes small and densely clumped, closely packed rather than widely spread
Background red cells largely normocytic with central pallor; no macro-ovalocytes evident
Scattered platelets and fine stain precipitate in the background
63052.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (two panels) shows isolated granulocytes with striking nuclear hypersegmentation, each nucleus composed of multiple small, compact, clumped lobes. One cell displays more basophilic cytoplasm. The red cells are largely normocytic without obvious macro-ovalocytes, and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with acquired neutrophil hypersegmentation in the setting of SARS-CoV-2 infection; B12/folate deficiency and drug effect should be excluded.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic hypersegmentation is accompanied by macro-ovalocytes and large neutrophils with spread-out lobes, which are not seen here; serum B12/folate confirm.
Morphology can be identical; distinction relies on medication history.
Apoptotic neutrophils show round, smooth, pyknotic nuclear fragments with dense homogeneous chromatin, whereas true hypersegmentation shows connected lobes with chromatin texture.

62988.recognize_zh: 淋巴結內一團界線清楚的大型組織球聚集，細胞質豐富、淡粉紅至泡沫狀，部分組織球細胞質內含完整小淋巴球（emperipolesis），外圍被一圈小淋巴球包圍，型態類似 Rosai-Dorfman 型組織球變化。
features: Well-circumscribed nodular aggregate of large histiocytes rimmed by a cuff of small lymphocytes
Histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic to foamy cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli
Occasional histiocytes containing intact small lymphocytes within the cytoplasm (emperipolesis)
Admixed small lymphocytes and plasma cells within and around the aggregate
Surrounding interfollicular tissue with small lymphocytes, plasma cells and prominent small vessels
62988.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a well-circumscribed aggregate of large histiocytes with abundant pale, eosinophilic to foamy cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei, surrounded by a rim of small lymphocytes. Occasional histiocytes contain intact lymphocytes within their cytoplasm (emperipolesis). The surrounding parenchyma contains small lymphocytes, plasma cells and prominent vessels. Findings are suggestive of Rosai-Dorfman-type histiocytic change, here as a focal finding in a lymph node from a patient with systemic mastocytosis; S100 and CD1a immunostains help confirm.

ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved, kidney-shaped nuclei with eosinophils and are CD1a+/langerin+, whereas Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes have round nuclei with emperipolesis and are S100+/CD1a-.
Reactive sinus histiocytes lack emperipolesis and are S100-negative.
Mast cells are spindled to oval with granular cytoplasm and tryptase/CD117+, whereas these large histiocytes engulf lymphocytes and are S100+.
Epithelioid granulomas have elongated nuclei, multinucleated giant cells and sometimes necrosis, without emperipolesis.

62924.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片紅血球大小不均，混有小紅血球、較大圓形紅血球、標靶細胞、鋸齒狀細胞與碎片，部分紅血球內有細小深色點狀包涵體（可能是 Howell-Jolly 小體）；此視野沒有有核紅血球，單看此圖只能說符合嚴重溶血/無效造血型貧血，需配合其他圖片與臨床。
features: Marked anisocytosis with microcytes and larger round cells
Target cells and cells with irregular central pallor
Crenated/echinocytic cells and red cell fragments
Small dark punctate inclusions in a few red cells, possibly Howell-Jolly bodies
No nucleated red cells or leukocytes in this field; scattered platelets
62924.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with microcytes, larger round cells, target cells, crenated forms, and red cell fragments. A few red cells contain small dark punctate inclusions that may represent Howell-Jolly bodies, although the resolution limits characterization. No nucleated red cells or leukocytes are present in this field, and platelets are scattered. In the clinical context and with the other fields from this case, findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia major.

ddx.vs: The smear appearance is indistinguishable; hemoglobin HPLC/electrophoresis is needed.
Post-splenectomy smears show target cells, Howell-Jolly bodies, and acanthocytes but without the marked microcytic anisopoikilocytosis of thalassemia.
IDA shows pencil cells and hypochromic microcytes but not Howell-Jolly bodies or numerous fragments and target cells.

62860.recognize_zh: 血球計數儀（Beckman Coulter LH750）畫面：RBC 直方圖出現兩個峰（小球性與正常大小族群），並跳出 Dimorphic Reds 與 Hypochromia 警示；MCV 68.7 fL、RDW 35.1% 顯著升高，小紅血球干擾 PLT 直方圖右端，符合鐵粒母細胞性貧血的雙族群紅血球。
features: RBC histogram with a bimodal curve: a microcytic peak below ~70 fL and a normocytic peak (blue arrow)
Instrument flags: Anemia, Anisocytosis, Dimorphic Reds, Giant Platelets, Hypochromia
RBC 2.47 x10^12/L, MCV 68.7 fL, markedly raised RDW 35.1
PLT histogram fails to return to baseline at ~20 fL due to microcytic red cell interference (orange arrow)
WBC 4.9 with a normal-appearing WBC histogram; platelets 333
62860.describe_en: This is a screenshot of an automated hematology analyzer (Beckman Coulter LH750) rather than a morphologic image. The RBC histogram is bimodal, with a microcytic population to the left of a normocytic peak, and the analyzer flags dimorphic reds, anisocytosis and hypochromia; indices show anemia (RBC 2.47), microcytosis (MCV 68.7 fL) and a markedly elevated RDW (35.1). The upper end of the platelet histogram does not return to baseline because small red cells are counted in the platelet channel, which also triggers a giant platelet flag and may overestimate the platelet count. The WBC histogram is normal. A dimorphic red cell population with microcytosis should prompt smear review and iron studies, and is consistent with X-linked sideroblastic anemia in this case.

ddx.dx: Recently treated iron deficiency or post-transfusion state
ddx.vs: These also produce a bimodal RBC histogram, but history and iron studies (low ferritin, or donor cells) distinguish them from sideroblastic anemia.

ddx.dx: True giant platelets or platelet clumping
ddx.vs: The giant platelet flag here reflects microcytic red cell interference, which smear review confirms by the absence of large platelets or clumps.

62796.recognize_zh: 這是血紅素HPLC報告：S-window峰占71.8%為最大峰，HbF 16.1%、HbA2 1.9%，Ao僅8.5%，呈HbS為主、F升高的圖形，符合鐮刀型貧血。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC chromatogram with peak table
Dominant peak in the S-window at 4.36 min (71.8% area)
Elevated HbF peak at 1.15 min (16.1%)
HbA2 1.9% at 3.62 min; small Ao peak at 2.44 min (8.5%)
Non-morphologic image; a small Ao fraction may reflect recent transfusion or glycated/adduct hemoglobins and should be correlated clinically
62796.describe_en: Cation-exchange high-performance liquid chromatography shows a dominant peak eluting in the S-window at 4.36 minutes comprising 71.8% of total hemoglobin, with HbF 16.1% and HbA2 1.9%. A small Ao peak (8.5%) is present, which should be correlated with transfusion history, as HbSS itself produces no HbA. There is no additional variant peak. Findings are consistent with sickle cell anemia (HbSS) with elevated HbF; confirmation with a sickle solubility test and family studies is appropriate.

ddx.vs: HbS/β0-thalassemia has a similar S-dominant profile but HbA2 is typically above 3.5% with microcytosis, whereas HbA2 is 1.9% here.
HbS/β+-thalassemia shows a substantial HbA fraction (usually 5–30%) with raised HbA2 and microcytosis; transfusion history and indices help separate it from the small Ao seen here.
HbD elutes in a distinct D-window (about 4.0–4.1 min) rather than the S-window and gives a negative solubility test.
HbS/HPFH has higher, pancellular HbF (typically 20–30%) with a mild clinical course and normal HbA2.

62732.recognize_zh: 中央一個核較大、胞質淡且含碎屑的巨噬細胞，周圍環繞一圈核圓而深染、胞質深藍的晚期紅血球前驅細胞，呈玫瑰花環狀排列，即骨髓中的紅血球島（erythroid island），屬正常結構。
features: Central macrophage with an oval, finely reticulated nucleus and pale, ill-defined cytoplasm containing small granules/debris
Ring of erythroid precursors (polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts) surrounding the macrophage
Erythroid precursors with round, dense, clumped nuclei and deeply basophilic to grey-blue cytoplasm
Background of neutrophils, band forms and myelocytes with granular cytoplasm
Numerous red cells; intense blue hue of MGG stain in this preparation
62732.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a central macrophage with an oval nucleus and pale, finely granular cytoplasm surrounded by a rosette of maturing erythroid precursors with round, condensed nuclei and basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm. Background granulocytic precursors and neutrophils appear morphologically unremarkable. No dysplastic erythroid features (nuclear budding, multinuclearity, megaloblastoid chromatin) are evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a normal erythroblastic island.

ddx.vs: In hemophagocytosis the erythroid cells are engulfed within the macrophage cytoplasm, whereas in an erythroid island they are arranged around the outside of the macrophage.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor cluster
ddx.vs: Tumor clusters are cohesive groups of larger, atypical cells with nuclear molding and fine chromatin and lack a central macrophage and orderly erythroid maturation.
Lymphocytes have scant pale blue cytoplasm and coarse but less dense chromatin, and do not form a rosette around a central macrophage.

62668.recognize_zh: IgM 染色中，大型腫瘤細胞呈強烈、瀰漫的細胞質陽性，核呈負染的空泡狀，周圍有中度背景染色；PEL 典型上不表現免疫球蛋白，因此這種細胞質 IgM 表現須與 HHV8 陽性 DLBCL 等病變鑑別。
features: Large tumor cells with intense diffuse cytoplasmic IgM staining
Negatively outlined large vesicular nuclei with nucleoli
Variable staining intensity among tumor cells, some weakly stained
Moderate diffuse background (interstitial) staining
Smaller spindle and lymphoid cells in stroma largely negative
62668.describe_en: IgM immunohistochemistry shows large neoplastic cells with intense, diffuse cytoplasmic staining surrounding large vesicular nuclei, with variable intensity among cells and moderate background interstitial staining. Smaller stromal and lymphoid cells are largely negative. Primary effusion lymphoma usually lacks surface and cytoplasmic immunoglobulin, so this degree of IgM expression is unusual and warrants correlation with light chain studies and background staining controls. In combination with HHV8 positivity, the findings are reported as part of an extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma phenotype in this case, but HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (typically IgM lambda) should be considered.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Characteristically expresses cytoplasmic IgM lambda, is EBER-negative and often retains CD20, arising in HHV8-positive multicentric Castleman disease.
Also HHV8 and EBV positive plasmablasts, but they partially replace germinal centers and are usually polytypic or IgM-negative.

ddx.dx: Lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma / IgM plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: Cytoplasmic IgM in small plasmacytoid lymphocytes or mature plasma cells, without large atypical plasmablasts or HHV8.

62604.recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交高倍圖：在淡粉紅色對比染色的背景下，許多腫瘤細胞核呈深藍黑色訊號，細胞質不著色，表示 EBV 感染腫瘤細胞。
features: Densely cellular infiltrate with pink/red counterstain
Numerous nuclei with dark blue-black EBER signal, varying in intensity
Signal confined to nuclei; cytoplasm and stroma unstained
Positive cells include intermediate and large atypical forms
Section shows some crush/processing artifact that limits crispness
62604.describe_en: EBER in situ hybridization shows nuclear signal in a large proportion of the neoplastic cells, with dark blue-black staining confined to nuclei against a pink counterstain. Positive cells include larger atypical forms, indicating EBV infection of the tumor rather than scattered bystander lymphocytes, although some processing artifact reduces sharpness. In a transplant recipient with a CD20-negative, MUM1-positive, light-chain-restricted plasma cell proliferation, findings are consistent with EBV-positive plasmacytoma-like post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Conventional plasma cell neoplasms are typically EBER-negative, whereas diffuse tumor-cell EBER favors PTLD.

ddx.dx: Reactive lesion with scattered EBV-positive bystanders
ddx.vs: Bystander EBV infection shows only rare positive small lymphocytes, not signal in the majority of the atypical cells.
PEL is often EBER-positive too but is defined by HHV8/LANA nuclear positivity.

62540.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片高倍下可見一個細胞質藍色、含多個分開圓核的大細胞（左中央，推測為核分離的異常巨核細胞），紅血球系前驅細胞中有雙核與核形不規則者，核染色質呈類巨母細胞樣；這些雙系異常變化支持 RCC 的診斷。
features: Large cell with blue granular cytoplasm and multiple separated round nuclei, suggestive of a dysplastic megakaryocyte
Erythroid precursors with binucleation and irregular nuclear contours
Megaloblastoid chromatin in some erythroid precursors
Granulocytic precursors at various stages, including a cell with coarse orange-brown granules
Occasional small hypolobated or bilobed nuclei
62540.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a cellular field of mixed hematopoietic precursors. A large cell with blue granular cytoplasm and several widely separated round nuclei is present, suggestive of a dysplastic megakaryocyte. Erythroid precursors show binucleation, irregular nuclear contours, and megaloblastoid chromatin, and granulocytic precursors are present at various maturation stages without an increase in blasts in this field. These dysplastic features, in a child with persistent cytopenia and a hypocellular marrow, are consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, and corrects with vitamin replacement.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19 infection or drug-related dyserythropoiesis
ddx.vs: Reactive dyserythropoiesis is transient, may show giant pronormoblasts with parvovirus, and lacks megakaryocytic dysplasia.
Fanconi anemia can show similar dysplasia, so chromosome breakage testing is required.

62476.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有一顆小到中型淋巴球，染色質粗塊狀，細胞質中等量偏藍，細胞邊緣可見短而細的絨毛狀突起（villous projections），符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤的絨毛淋巴球（villous lymphocyte）。
features: Small to medium-sized lymphoid cell, slightly larger than a mature small lymphocyte
Round nucleus with condensed, clumped chromatin; no conspicuous nucleolus
Moderate rim of pale-blue cytoplasm
Short, fine cytoplasmic villous projections along part of the cell border
Background red cells show a few target-like forms and no rouleaux or nucleated red cells
62476.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small to medium-sized lymphoid cell with a round nucleus, condensed chromatin, and a moderate amount of pale basophilic cytoplasm bearing short, fine villous projections at the cell margin. No prominent nucleolus is seen. The surrounding red cells show occasional target-like forms; platelets are not prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with a circulating villous lymphocyte, as seen in splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells have more abundant pale-grey cytoplasm with circumferential hair-like projections and oval or bean-shaped nuclei with looser chromatin, and are CD25/CD103/CD11c positive with BRAF V600E.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: These cells show a distinct central nucleolus and are CD25 negative, unlike the nucleolus-poor villous lymphocyte here.
CLL cells are small with scant cytoplasm lacking villi, 'soccer-ball' chromatin and smudge cells, and are CD5/CD23 positive.
Artifactual cytoplasmic irregularity is usually seen in cells at the thin edge of the smear and lacks a clonal B-cell population on flow cytometry.

62412.recognize_zh: kappa 輕鏈原位雜交（ISH）染色的骨髓組織中，可見大量散在或小群聚、細胞質呈深藍黑色訊號的陽性漿細胞，數量明顯多於同一檢體 lambda ISH 的少數陽性細胞——表示 kappa 輕鏈限制的單株漿細胞族群。
features: Bone marrow tissue with fat spaces and a hemorrhagic eosinophilic background
Numerous cells with dark blue-black cytoplasmic kappa ISH signal
Positive cells distributed singly and in small clusters throughout the field
Positive cells show a perinuclear cytoplasmic rim of signal consistent with plasma cells
Low image resolution limits detailed cytology
62412.describe_en: In situ hybridization for kappa light-chain mRNA on a bone marrow section shows numerous positive cells with dark cytoplasmic signal, present singly and in small clusters among fat spaces and a hemorrhagic background. Compared with the lambda ISH on the same specimen, which marks only rare cells, there is a marked excess of kappa-positive plasma cells. Image resolution limits cytologic detail. Findings indicate a kappa light-chain-restricted clonal plasma cell population, supporting lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma in the appropriate morphologic and clinical context.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are a mixture with a kappa-to-lambda ratio of about 1-3:1, whereas this case shows marked kappa predominance.
Myeloma shows light-chain restriction with sheets of often atypical plasma cells, CD56 or cyclin D1 expression and no clonal small B-cell component.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Restriction is shared, and separation depends on IgM paraprotein, marrow pattern and MYD88 L265P rather than the ISH itself.
True ISH signal is crisp, cytoplasmic and cell-associated, whereas background artifact is diffuse and also overlies red cells and stroma.

62348.recognize_zh: 中倍下一個濾泡中央只剩很小的萎縮生發中心，一條管壁透明化的血管從外面筆直穿入其中，形成「棒棒糖（lollipop）」外觀，周圍是很寬、小淋巴球排列成同心圓的外套區，符合透明血管型 Castleman 病。
features: Small atretic germinal center with hyalinized, eosinophilic material at the follicle center
Single sclerotic vessel radially penetrating the follicle into the germinal center (lollipop lesion)
Markedly expanded mantle zone of small mature lymphocytes in vague concentric layers
Interfollicular areas with increased small vessels
No atypical large cells or sheets of plasma cells in this field
62348.describe_en: Lymph node section at medium power shows a lymphoid follicle with a small, regressed germinal center containing hyalinized eosinophilic material. A sclerotic, hyalinized vessel penetrates radially from the interfollicular region into the germinal center, producing a lollipop configuration. The surrounding mantle zone is broad and composed of small, cytologically bland lymphocytes arranged in vague concentric layers, and the interfollicular stroma is vascular. No atypical large cells are identified. Findings are consistent with unicentric Castleman disease, hyaline vascular type.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphoid hyperplasia with regressed follicles
ddx.vs: Nonspecific regressed follicles (e.g., HIV, autoimmune disease) lack the consistent broad onion-skin mantles and penetrating hyalinized vessels across many follicles.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL expands mantles with slightly irregular cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, CD5-positive monotonous cells, whereas Castleman mantle cells are polyclonal and cyclin D1-negative.

FDC sarcoma forms fascicles or storiform sheets of spindle cells with atypia (CD21/CD23/CD35-positive), not intact follicles with atretic germinal centers; it may arise in hyaline vascular Castleman disease.
AITL shows effaced architecture with arborizing HEVs, clear atypical T cells and expanded CD21-positive FDC meshworks outside follicles rather than preserved follicles with onion-skin mantles.

62284.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞密集，以體積大、染色質開放的紅血球前驅細胞為主，視野中同時可見多個有絲分裂像，成熟中的紅血球前驅細胞仍保留細點狀染色質，呈現紅血球系增生與核質發育不同步，符合巨母紅血球性貧血。
features: Hypercellular aspirate dominated by erythroid precursors (decreased M:E ratio)
Multiple mitotic figures in large erythroid precursors
Enlarged megaloblasts with open, finely stippled chromatin and deep blue cytoplasm
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony in polychromatic erythroblasts
Scattered granulocytic precursors with pink granular cytoplasm and a small cluster of nuclear fragments (karyorrhexis)
Macrocytic and oval red cells in the background
62284.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is highly cellular with marked erythroid hyperplasia and a decreased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio. The erythroid precursors are enlarged and show open, finely stippled chromatin that is immature relative to their basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm, and several mitotic figures are present in the field. Scattered granulocytic precursors and a small cluster of karyorrhectic nuclear fragments are also seen, reflecting ineffective erythropoiesis. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia; the increased mitoses reflect the proliferative but ineffective marrow and should not by themselves be interpreted as neoplasia.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of immature proerythroblasts without maturation, often with cytoplasmic vacuoles and TP53 mutation, whereas here there is a full asynchronous maturation spectrum.
Hemolysis produces normoblastic erythroid hyperplasia with condensed chromatin appropriate for cytoplasmic maturation, without megaloblasts or giant metamyelocytes.
MDS shows megaloblastoid erythroids with dysplastic megakaryocytes and neutrophils and clonal cytogenetics, and does not correct with B12/folate replacement.
Antimetabolite-induced megaloblastosis is morphologically identical and is identified by drug history with normal vitamin levels.

62220.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結內有一束束呈流線狀排列的紡錘形細胞（spindle cell），穿插在淋巴組織之間並繞過濾泡，與正常結構容易混淆；需靠 Melan-A、S100 等免疫染色確認為轉移性紡錘細胞黑色素瘤。
features: Sweeping fascicles of spindle cells with elongated, hyperchromatic nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm
Spindle cells track through sinuses and interfollicular zones around lymphoid aggregates
Preserved dense small-lymphocyte areas (follicle-like) at the right
Occasional mitotic figures within the spindle cell bands
No melanin pigment visible at this low magnification
62220.describe_en: Section of lymph node at low power shows fascicles of spindle cells that sweep through the sinuses and interfollicular areas, dividing the residual lymphoid tissue into nodules while sparing follicles. The spindle cells have elongated hyperchromatic nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm, with occasional mitoses; melanin pigment is not evident. At this magnification the infiltrate can mimic nodal stroma or capsular trabeculae. With the reported Melan-A and S100 positivity, findings are consistent with metastatic spindle cell melanoma.

ddx.vs: Kaposi sarcoma forms slit-like vascular spaces with extravasated red cells and hyaline globules and is HHV8 (LANA-1) positive, not S100/Melan-A positive.
IDCS is S100 positive but negative for Melan-A, HMB45 and SOX10-associated melanocytic markers and lacks a primary skin melanoma history.
FDCS shows whorled spindle cells expressing CD21, CD23 and CD35, and is negative for S100 and Melan-A.
These are distinguished immunohistochemically by cytokeratin or lineage-specific markers (e.g. desmin, SMA) with negative melanocytic markers.

62156.recognize_zh: 臨床照片：背部與肩頸有多條線狀、交錯的色素沉著條紋，外觀像鞭痕（flagellate pigmentation），符合 bleomycin 引起的鞭痕狀皮疹。
features: Multiple linear and curvilinear hyperpigmented streaks over the upper back, shoulders and posterior neck
Criss-crossing whip-like (flagellate) pattern, most confluent over the upper back
Streaks follow scratch-like distribution rather than dermatomes
No vesicles, ulceration or scaling evident at this resolution
Alopecia of the scalp consistent with chemotherapy exposure
62156.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the patient's back shows numerous linear and criss-crossing hyperpigmented streaks, most prominent over the upper back and shoulders and extending onto the neck, in a whip-mark (flagellate) pattern. No blistering, ulceration or scale is evident at this resolution, and scalp hair loss is present. In a patient receiving bleomycin, the appearance is consistent with bleomycin-induced flagellate dermatitis/hyperpigmentation.

ddx.vs: Shiitake dermatitis produces a similar pruritic flagellate eruption but follows ingestion of raw or undercooked shiitake mushrooms without bleomycin exposure.
Dermatomyositis shows erythematous rather than purely pigmented streaks, with heliotrope rash, Gottron papules and proximal muscle weakness.
Traumatic whip marks show fresh bruising, abrasions or healing scars in a pattern matched to history, rather than pruritus-related pigmentation after chemotherapy.
Phytophotodermatitis produces streaky hyperpigmentation on sun-exposed areas after contact with plant furocoumarins and sunlight.

62092.recognize_zh: 核型式為 46,XY,t(3;3)(q21;q26.2),t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)：箭頭標示 der(9)、縮短的 der(22)（費城染色體）與兩條重排的 3 號染色體；間期 FISH 以 BCR（綠）/ABL1（紅）探針可見黃色融合訊號，確認 BCR::ABL1。
features: G-banded karyotype: 46,XY,t(3;3)(q21;q26.2),t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)
Arrows mark der(9), the shortened der(22) (Philadelphia chromosome), and both rearranged chromosome 3 homologs
Partial karyotype inset pairs normal 9 and 22 with their derivatives
Interphase FISH (BCR green, ABL1 red): yellow fusion signals indicating BCR::ABL1
Additional t(3;3) places MECOM (EVI1) near RPN1 enhancer, an adverse secondary change
62092.describe_en: This composite is a non-morphologic cytogenetic figure. The G-banded karyotype shows 46,XY,t(3;3)(q21;q26.2),t(9;22)(q34;q11.2), with the Philadelphia chromosome [der(22)] and der(9) indicated along with rearranged chromosome 3 homologs. Interphase dual-color FISH with BCR (green) and ABL1 (red) probes demonstrates fused yellow signals in both nuclei, confirming BCR::ABL1. The coexisting t(3;3)(q21;q26.2), which juxtaposes MECOM with RPN1, is a high-risk additional chromosomal abnormality associated with blast phase, TKI resistance, and poor prognosis in CML.

ddx.vs: Carries the same t(9;22) (often p190 BCR::ABL1), so distinction relies on marrow morphology/flow and history rather than the karyotype alone.
Shows the MECOM rearrangement but no Philadelphia chromosome and no BCR::ABL1 fusion signals on FISH.
Complex or cryptic variants may lack a visible der(22) on G-banding but still show BCR::ABL1 fusion by FISH or RT-PCR.

61964.recognize_zh: PAX5染色只在散在的小型B細胞核呈強陽性，而大多數核大、淡染的腫瘤細胞為陰性（僅見顆粒狀背景），PAX5陰性可幫忙排除cHL（弱陽性）與B細胞淋巴瘤，支持ALCL。
features: Strong nuclear PAX5 staining in scattered small cells (residual B cells)
Large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei are PAX5-negative
Some positive nuclei in small pairs or clusters
Faint granular cytoplasmic/background staining that should not be interpreted as nuclear positivity
61964.describe_en: PAX5 immunostain shows strong nuclear staining in scattered small reactive B cells, while the large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei are negative, with only faint nonspecific granular background. Absence of PAX5 in the neoplastic cells argues against a B-cell lymphoma and against classic Hodgkin lymphoma, which typically shows weak nuclear PAX5 in HRS cells. Findings support anaplastic large cell lymphoma in this context.

ddx.vs: HRS cells show weak nuclear PAX5 (dimmer than background B cells), whereas ALCL tumor cells are completely PAX5-negative.
DLBCL cells show strong nuclear PAX5 in the large cell population.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is also PAX5/CD20-negative but expresses CD138, MUM1 and is often EBER-positive, not uniform CD30 with T-cell markers.

61900.recognize_zh: 以紅色複染的 EBER 原位雜交中，皮下脂肪小葉間與真皮的浸潤淋巴球有許多深藍黑色核訊號，代表 EBV 感染的淋巴細胞，這是診斷 HV 樣淋巴增生性疾病（HVLPD）的關鍵染色。
features: Subcutaneous adipose tissue and deep dermal collagen with an interstitial lymphoid infiltrate
Many infiltrating small to medium lymphoid nuclei show dark blue-black nuclear signal
Pink/red counterstain typical of chromogenic ISH (e.g., NBT/BCIP with nuclear fast red)
Positive nuclei distributed between adipocytes and along septa and collagen bundles
Some elongated stromal nuclei also appear dark, so background staining cannot be fully excluded at this resolution
61900.describe_en: EBER in situ hybridization with a red counterstain on a skin biopsy shows a lymphoid infiltrate involving the deep dermis and subcutaneous fat. Many infiltrating lymphoid cells show dark blue-black nuclear signal, distributed between adipocytes and along fibrous septa and collagen bundles. Some elongated stromal nuclei also appear dark, so interpretation should be confirmed against positive and negative controls. Findings indicate a substantial population of EBV-infected lymphocytes, consistent with hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoproliferative disorder in the appropriate clinical and immunophenotypic context.

ddx.vs: SPTCL shows CD8-positive, beta F1-positive adipocyte rimming and is EBER negative, whereas this infiltrate contains many EBER-positive cells.
