ENKTL is also EBER positive but shows angiocentric, angiodestructive growth with necrosis and CD56-positive cells, usually in adults without photodistributed vesiculopapules.

Classic HV may contain EBER-positive cells but is a self-limited childhood photodermatosis without systemic symptoms or persistent high EBV DNA load; distinction relies on clinical course rather than histology.

61836.recognize_zh: 這是次世代定序（NGS）在 IGV 瀏覽器中的讀段比對截圖，位於第 3 號染色體 q21 區（GATA2 所在）；紅色箭頭處約一部分讀段在同一位置出現綠色鹼基（A），覆蓋度條呈雙色，代表異合子點突變，支持 GATA2 胚系突變。
features: Integrative Genomics Viewer (IGV) screenshot of aligned sequencing reads (gray bars)
Chromosome ideogram with red marker in the 3q21 region, consistent with the GATA2 locus
Single-nucleotide variant at the arrowed position shown in green (A) in a subset of reads
Split-color coverage track (orange/green) at that position indicating two alleles
Rare scattered isolated mismatches elsewhere consistent with background sequencing error
61836.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic figure: an IGV display of next-generation sequencing reads aligned to the 3q21 region (GATA2 locus). At the arrowed position, a subset of reads carries a single-nucleotide substitution displayed in green, and the coverage bar is split between the reference and alternate alleles, indicating a heterozygous variant; exact allele fraction cannot be read from the screenshot. Scattered isolated mismatches elsewhere lack consistency across reads and represent background noise. A variant allele fraction near 50%, confirmed in non-hematopoietic tissue (e.g. skin fibroblasts) and by Sanger sequencing, supports a germline GATA2 mutation underlying the myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Somatic mutations (e.g. in CEBPA-biallelic AML) are restricted to hematopoietic cells and often have low VAF, whereas germline variants are present at ~50% in fibroblast or hair-follicle DNA.
Artifacts show strand bias, low base quality, or mismatches clustered at read ends, whereas a true variant is present consistently across overlapping reads in both directions.
Population databases (gnomAD) and ClinVar curation are needed to classify the variant as pathogenic rather than a benign SNP.

61772.recognize_zh: H&E 下大型組織球細胞質豐富淡染、胞質內包著一整群小淋巴球與漿細胞（emperipolesis，中央與左下兩群最清楚），周圍有細胞質空泡與淋巴漿細胞背景，是 Rosai-Dorfman disease 的特徵畫面。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated eosinophilic cytoplasm
Striking emperipolesis: clusters of 10-20 intact small lymphocytes within single histiocytes (center and lower left)
Engulfed cells retain intact nuclei, some with a surrounding clear halo, including plasma cells
Histiocyte nuclei are oval with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli, partly obscured by engulfed cells
Background small lymphocytes and plasma cells with vacuolated stroma and clear spaces
61772.describe_en: Sections show sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm and oval vesicular nuclei. Several histiocytes contain numerous intact lymphocytes and plasma cells within their cytoplasm, forming prominent clusters of emperipolesis. The background consists of small lymphocytes and plasma cells without significant atypia. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease, which would be supported by S100 and OCT2 positivity in the histiocytes with CD1a negativity.

ddx.vs: Shows grooved nuclei with eosinophils and CD1a/langerin positivity, lacking intact lymphocytes within histiocyte cytoplasm.
Macrophages phagocytose and degrade red cells, platelets and nucleated cells (true phagocytosis) and are S100 negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in sinuses
ddx.vs: Tumor cells are cohesive with nuclear atypia and keratin or melanocytic markers, and cell-in-cell engulfment is not organized emperipolesis.
Histiocytes are smaller, S100 negative and lack clusters of engulfed lymphocytes.

61708.recognize_zh: 這是間期細胞核的螢光原位雜交（FISH），DAPI 藍色核內有 2 個分開的綠色訊號與 2 個分開的紅色訊號，沒有紅綠重疊的融合訊號；若使用 PML/RARA 雙融合探針，此為正常（無融合）訊號型態。
features: Single interphase nucleus counterstained with DAPI (blue)
Two discrete green signals and two discrete red signals
No colocalized red-green (yellow) fusion signals
Signal pattern 2R2G, i.e. normal for a dual-color dual-fusion probe
61708.describe_en: Interphase FISH shows a single DAPI-counterstained nucleus with two separate green and two separate red signals and no colocalized fusion signal. If a PML/RARA dual-color dual-fusion probe was used (probe identity and color assignment are not labeled), this 2R2G pattern is normal and does not demonstrate PML::RARA fusion in this cell. A single nucleus cannot represent the overall result, which requires scoring a defined number of nuclei; a negative pattern may also occur with cryptic insertions below probe resolution, so RT-PCR for PML::RARA is recommended when APL is suspected morphologically.

61644.recognize_zh: 中倍下骨小樑旁有一大片細胞質淡紫、核圓且染色質細緻的較大細胞聚集，與周圍含許多嗜酸性球、成熟顆粒球及紅血球的骨髓分界清楚；大型未成熟紅系前驅細胞群配合嗜酸性球增加，提示 PCM1::JAK2 相關骨髓腫瘤。
features: Large sheet-like aggregate of medium to large immature cells with round nuclei and pale amphophilic cytoplasm
Aggregates adjacent to bony trabeculae and relatively well demarcated from surrounding marrow
Background marrow with maturing granulocytes including numerous eosinophils
Interstitial hemorrhage/red cells in background
Occasional megakaryocytes
61644.describe_en: Medium-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows a large, relatively well-demarcated aggregate of medium to large immature cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and pale amphophilic cytoplasm adjacent to a bony trabecula. The surrounding marrow contains maturing granulocytes with conspicuous eosinophils, scattered megakaryocytes and interstitial red cells. The lineage of the aggregate cannot be established on H&E alone, but glycophorin C immunostaining identifies these as immature erythroid precursors. The combination of expanded immature erythroid islands and eosinophilia is consistent with myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PCM1::JAK2.

ddx.vs: AML blasts are CD34/CD117/MPO positive and glycophorin negative, and blasts count toward at least 20% in marrow.
Requires more than 80% erythroid cells with at least 30% proerythroblasts, whereas here the erythroid islands are admixed with abundant granulopoiesis and eosinophils.
Mast cell aggregates are paratrabecular with spindled cells, eosinophil rims and fibrosis, and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive.
Lymphoma cells are CD45 and CD20 or CD3 positive, glycophorin negative.

61580.recognize_zh: 上胸與腹部皮膚散布大量紫紅色至暗紅色、大小不一的丘疹與圓頂狀結節，表面光滑，最大者約 1 公分；在白血病病人出現這種多發性紫紅色結節應懷疑白血病皮膚浸潤（leukemia cutis），需切片確認。
features: Numerous disseminated violaceous to red-purple papules and dome-shaped nodules on the chest and abdomen
Lesions vary from a few millimeters to about 1 cm, several with a smooth shiny surface
No ulceration, scale or vesiculation on the lesions
Intervening skin shows mild xerosis; no dermatomal or follicular distribution
61580.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the anterior trunk shows innumerable disseminated violaceous to erythematous papules and firm-appearing dome-shaped nodules measuring from a few millimeters to approximately 1 cm, without ulceration or scale. The distribution is widespread and non-dermatomal. In a patient with acute myeloid leukemia this appearance is suggestive of leukemia cutis; skin biopsy with immunohistochemistry is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Vasculitis presents as palpable purpura favoring dependent legs that do not blanch and are smaller and more uniform, and biopsy shows fibrinoid vessel damage rather than a dermal blast infiltrate.
KS nodules are violaceous but tend to be oval along skin lines, and biopsy shows HHV8+ spindle cells with slit-like vascular spaces.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous B-cell lymphoma or blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: These look clinically similar; skin biopsy immunophenotype (CD20, or CD4/CD56/CD123 for BPDCN, versus MPO/CD33/lysozyme for myeloid sarcoma) is required.
Sweet syndrome lesions are tender, edematous pseudovesicular plaques with fever, and histology shows mature neutrophils rather than blasts.

61516.recognize_zh: 這是細胞遺傳學圖片而非形態學影像：左側為 G 顯帶中期分裂相，箭頭標示三條 8 號染色體，右側核型圖第 8 對被圈起並有三條，性染色體為 X 與 Y，即 47,XY,+8 的第 8 對三體。
features: Left panel: G-banded metaphase spread with arrows marking three copies of chromosome 8
Right panel: karyogram with three chromosome 8 homologs (circled) and otherwise paired autosomes
Sex chromosomes X and Y present, giving a male karyotype of 47 chromosomes
No structural rearrangement evident at this banding resolution
Figure header labels the right panel as an interphase cell, but it is actually an arranged karyogram
61516.describe_en: This figure is a cytogenetic image rather than a morphologic one. The left panel shows a G-banded metaphase with arrows marking three copies of chromosome 8, and the right panel is a karyogram with three chromosome 8 homologs (circled), one X, and one Y, without apparent structural abnormalities; the header mislabels the karyogram as an interphase cell. The findings represent trisomy 8 as a sole abnormality in a clonal population, reported as 47,XY,+8[13]/46,XY[7]. In a patient with MPO-negative AML confirmed by immunophenotyping, trisomy 8 is an intermediate-risk abnormality, and molecular testing should look for co-occurring mutations; constitutional trisomy 8 mosaicism should be excluded if clinically suspected.

ddx.vs: Constitutional mosaicism is present in PHA-stimulated lymphocytes or skin fibroblasts, whereas acquired +8 is restricted to the myeloid clone.
A secondary +8 accompanies recurrent rearrangements such as t(8;21), inv(16), or t(9;22), which are absent in the other analyzed chromosomes here.
MDS with +8 is distinguished from AML by a blast count below 20% and not by cytogenetics.

61452.recognize_zh: A 圖血液抹片可見多顆循環中的中到大型肥大細胞，核圓至卵圓、胞質含紫黑色嗜鹼性顆粒且顆粒外溢到周圍；配合 B–D 骨髓切片中瀰漫浸潤及免疫染色陽性，符合肥大細胞白血病進入白血病期。
features: Panel A: several circulating medium-to-large mast cells in peripheral blood with round to oval, centrally placed nuclei and moderately abundant cytoplasm
Cytoplasm contains dark purple metachromatic granules, unevenly distributed, with granules scattered outside the cells (degranulation)
Some mast cells show hypogranular areas and slightly irregular cytoplasmic outlines, consistent with atypical mast cells
Background RBCs are unremarkable; platelets and extracellular granules in background
Panels B-D (small insets): diffuse, dense marrow infiltrate on a special stain and two immunostains with positive cells replacing marrow (antibodies not labeled)
61452.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (panel A) shows multiple circulating mast cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, and cytoplasm filled with coarse basophilic granules, some partially degranulated with extracellular granules. Insets B-D show a diffuse, sheet-like bone marrow infiltrate on a special stain and immunostains highlighting the neoplastic mast cells; the specific markers are not labeled and are too small to assess in detail. In a patient with previously aleukemic mast cell leukemia, the appearance of numerous circulating mast cells indicates progression to a leukemic phase. Findings are consistent with mast cell leukemia, leukemic variant.

ddx.vs: Basophils have segmented nuclei obscured by large granules that are water-soluble, whereas mast cells have a round central nucleus and are CD117+ tryptase+ CD25+.
Blasts show sparse coarse granules and high N:C ratio and are CD123+/CD203c+ but usually lack KIT D816V and strong tryptase/CD25 of mast cells.
Promyelocytes have azurophilic red-purple granules, often bilobed nuclei and Auer rods, are MPO+, and lack metachromatic tryptase-positive granules.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with mast cell differentiation (myelomastocytic leukemia)
ddx.vs: Metachromatic blasts are present but they fail SM criteria (no dense tryptase+ aggregates, usually no KIT D816V or CD25).

61452.stain: Wright-Giemsa (A); unlabeled special stain and IHC (B-D)

61388.recognize_zh: 血液抹片的紅血球之間出現細長、深紫色、呈線狀或蜷曲的蟲體（A–C 低倍），D 高倍可見體寬均勻、染色深、末端漸細的蠕蟲型態，長度約數十個紅血球直徑，符合血中微絲蟲（microfilaria）。
features: Elongated slender worm-like organisms lying among red cells, straight in A and C and coiled in B and D
Length spans many red cell diameters (roughly 200-300 um) with a width of a few micrometers
Intensely basophilic body with tapering anterior and posterior ends (D)
Sheath and the arrangement of somatic nuclei in the tail cannot be resolved at this magnification and stain intensity
Background red cells, occasional neutrophils and small lymphocytes unremarkable
61388.describe_en: Peripheral blood smears (panels A-C, low power; panel D, high power) show several elongated, slender, intensely basophilic worm-like organisms lying free among red cells, measuring many red cell diameters in length and displaying straight to coiled configurations with tapered ends. The surrounding leukocytes and red cells are unremarkable. A sheath and the distribution of tail nuclei, which are needed for species identification, cannot be reliably assessed in these images. Findings are consistent with microfilaremia (filariasis); species determination requires evaluation of sheath, tail nuclei and size on Giemsa-stained thick films, correlated with periodicity of blood draw and travel history, or molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Sheathed microfilaria with a sheath that stains poorly with Giemsa and a tapered tail free of terminal nuclei, with nocturnal periodicity.
Sheathed microfilaria whose sheath stains pink with Giemsa, with a kinked appearance and two separate terminal tail nuclei.
Sheathed microfilaria with nuclei extending continuously to the tip of the tail, diurnal periodicity and African rainforest exposure.
Lacks internal nuclear column and tapered anatomic ends, and often lies out of the plane of focus or crosses cell outlines.

61324.recognize_zh: 組合圖中 B 可見大型多形性細胞與多核 Reed-Sternberg 樣細胞，易被誤認為古典何杰金淋巴瘤；但 C-F、H 免疫染色中大型細胞呈片狀強陽性，G 可見成片的大型腫瘤細胞，右下 TRG 基因重組分析出現單株峰，支持 T 細胞淋巴瘤（ALCL）。
features: Panel A: low-power H&E with diffuse effacement by a mixed cellular infiltrate
Panel B: large pleomorphic cells including multinucleated Reed-Sternberg-like cells
Panels C-F: immunostains with strong staining of large neoplastic cells in cohesive clusters and sheets (antibodies not labeled)
Panel G: cellular area with sheets of large atypical cells
Panel H: strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining of sheets of large cells
TRG capillary electrophoresis showing a dominant clonal peak
61324.describe_en: This composite figure shows a lymph node effaced by an infiltrate that on low power (A) is mixed, but at high power (B) contains large pleomorphic cells including multinucleated Reed-Sternberg-like forms. Immunostains (C-F, H; specific antibodies not labeled in the figure) highlight large neoplastic cells in cohesive clusters and sheets rather than scattered isolated cells, and a separate area (G) shows sheets of large atypical cells. T-cell receptor gamma PCR demonstrates a clonal peak. The combination of sheet-like growth and T-cell clonality favors anaplastic large cell lymphoma mimicking classic Hodgkin lymphoma; confirmation with CD30, ALK, EMA, CD15, PAX5, and T-cell markers is required.

ddx.vs: cHL shows scattered HRS cells that are PAX5 weakly positive, CD45-negative, and lack clonal TCR rearrangement, rather than sheets of CD30-positive T cells.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS with HRS-like cells
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS lacks uniform strong CD30 and hallmark cells, and HRS-like B cells in PTCL are EBV-positive bystanders.
These are morphologically similar and are separated by ALK immunohistochemistry or ALK rearrangement studies.

61196.recognize_zh: CSF 抹片中數顆細胞核偏心、染色質粗塊狀、細胞質藍色且邊緣有出芽狀突起，呈漿細胞樣；右側一顆核呈多葉狀，屬於非典型漿細胞，符合骨髓瘤侵犯中樞神經。
features: Five plasmacytoid cells scattered on a clean cytospin background, some in pairs
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with irregular blebs and projections
One cell (right) with a lobulated/multilobed nucleus, an atypical plasma cell feature
No accompanying lymphocytes, neutrophils or red cells
61196.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows scattered plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm bearing irregular blebs. One cell has a lobulated nucleus, indicating nuclear atypia. No reactive inflammatory background is present in this field. In a patient with multiple myeloma and neurologic symptoms, findings are consistent with CSF involvement by plasma cell myeloma, which should be confirmed by flow cytometry demonstrating clonal CD38+/CD138+ plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are sparse, cytologically mature and admixed with lymphocytes and monocytes, and are polytypic by flow cytometry.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with fine chromatin and gray vacuolated cytoplasm, and reactive lymphocytes lack eccentric nuclei with clock-face chromatin.

ddx.dx: CNS involvement by lymphoma with plasmacytoid features
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells express CD19/CD20 with a range of lymphoid sizes, whereas myeloma cells are CD19-/CD45-dim/CD138+.

61132.recognize_zh: S100 免疫染色下，大型組織球的細胞質與核強染成棕色，細胞質內有多個被「負染」圍出的圓形小淋巴球（周圍呈白色空暈），就是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的特徵：淋巴球穿入現象（emperipolesis）。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm showing strong nuclear and cytoplasmic S100 positivity
Intact small lymphocytes within histiocyte cytoplasm, sharply outlined as S100-negative round cells with clear halos (emperipolesis)
Histiocyte nuclei large, round to oval, some appearing as dense dark-brown staining
Background of S100-negative small lymphocytes and plasma cells with oval nuclei
Fibrillary/stromal background with scattered smaller S100-positive processes
61132.describe_en: S100 immunohistochemistry highlights scattered large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm and strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining. Several histiocytes contain intact small lymphocytes within their cytoplasm, which are negatively outlined as S100-negative round cells surrounded by clear halos, representing emperipolesis. The background consists of S100-negative small lymphocytes and plasma cells. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease (confirmation with CD68/CD163 and cyclin D1 or OCT2 as needed).

ddx.vs: LCH cells are also S100 positive but are smaller with grooved nuclei, CD1a/langerin positive, and lack emperipolesis.
Ordinary sinus histiocytes are S100 negative and do not show conspicuous emperipolesis.
Hemophagocytic histiocytes ingest and degrade red cells and nuclear debris and are S100 negative, whereas RDD histiocytes harbor viable intact lymphocytes.
Melanoma cells are S100 positive but show nuclear atypia, prominent nucleoli and SOX10/HMB45/Melan-A positivity without emperipolesis.

61068.recognize_zh: 周邊血片中一個中型細胞，核圓形偏位、染色質粗塊狀，細胞質深藍色並有核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），即循環中的漿細胞；單張只見一個細胞，無法據此計算是否超過 20%。
features: Single medium-sized cell with round, eccentrically placed nucleus
Coarse, clumped (clock-face-like) chromatin without conspicuous nucleolus
Moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone (hof)
Background red cells with rouleaux-like stacking
Refractile crystalline/debris artifacts and a weakly stained, yellow-tinged preparation
61068.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single circulating plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus, coarse chromatin, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof. Background red cells show rouleaux-like stacking, and refractile debris artifacts are present. Only one plasma cell is shown, so the proportion of circulating plasma cells cannot be assessed from this image. In a patient with myeloma and leukocytosis, a manual differential showing ≥5% circulating plasma cells (current WHO/IMWG threshold; historically ≥20%) would support plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasmacytoid lymphocytes are polytypic, have less eccentric nuclei and occur with other reactive lymphocyte forms rather than a clonal CD38+/CD138+ population.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes to plasmacytoid cells that express CD19/CD20 with MYD88 L265P.
Plasmablasts are larger with prominent nucleoli and open chromatin, often EBV-associated.

61004.recognize_zh: 低倍血片白血球明顯增多，除分葉嗜中性球外，還有大量未成熟顆粒球（骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀核）；右側放大插圖可見粗顆粒的骨髓球及顆粒稀少、分葉異常的嗜中性球，且未見明顯嗜鹼性球增多或單核球增多，符合 aCML 的血片特徵。
features: Marked leukocytosis with a left-shifted granulocytic series: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Insets: myelocytes/promyelocytes with coarse azurophilic granules and round-to-oval nuclei
Inset (lower): neutrophil lineage cells with abnormal nuclear shapes and a hypogranular neutrophil (dysgranulopoiesis)
No conspicuous basophilia or monocytosis in the field
Rare cells with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm; blasts not clearly increased
Red cells normocytic without marked poikilocytosis
61004.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed of neutrophils and numerous immature granulocytes, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes and bands. The high-power insets highlight myelocytes with coarse granulation and neutrophil-lineage cells with abnormal nuclear segmentation and cytoplasmic hypogranularity. Basophils and monocytes are not conspicuously increased and blasts are not obviously prominent. Red cells are unremarkable. In a BCR::ABL1-negative setting, these findings of neutrophilic leukocytosis with >=10% immature granulocytes and dysgranulopoiesis are consistent with atypical CML (MDS/MPN with neutrophilia).

ddx.vs: CML shows a 'myelocyte bulge' with absolute basophilia and eosinophilia but no dysgranulopoiesis, and carries BCR::ABL1.
CNL has predominantly mature, often toxic-granulated neutrophils with <10% immature granulocytes and no dysplasia.
Reactive left shift shows toxic granulation, Döhle bodies and vacuoles without hypogranular or abnormally segmented neutrophils and resolves with the cause.
CMML requires absolute monocytosis >=0.5 x 10^9/L and >=10% monocytes, not seen here.

60940.recognize_zh: 嗜中性球的細胞核分成六到十個以上小葉，並以中心為軸呈放射狀排列，像一朵花（flower-like/rosette nuclei）；下排較大的細胞細胞質偏藍、染色質較疏鬆，核也呈分葉花瓣狀，屬過度分葉的變異形態。
features: Neutrophils of normal to slightly increased size with nuclei divided into numerous (often >6) small round lobes
Lobes arranged radially around a central point, producing a flower- or rosette-like configuration
Lobes relatively compact with condensed chromatin; cytoplasm pale with fine neutrophilic granules
Panel B: larger cells with bluish cytoplasm and less condensed, lobulated/cloverleaf nuclei (monocyte or immature cells with similar nuclear change)
Background red cells largely normocytic with few platelets; no macro-ovalocytes evident
60940.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows many neutrophils with striking nuclear hypersegmentation, the nuclei consisting of numerous small compact lobes arranged radially in a flower-like or rosette pattern. Additional larger cells with bluish cytoplasm and less condensed chromatin show a similar lobulated, petal-like nuclear configuration. Red cells are without macro-ovalocytosis in these fields. The findings represent flower-like hypersegmentation of leukocyte nuclei; the image alone does not establish the cause, and considerations include heat-related injury (hyperthermia/heat stroke or specimen exposure to heat), in vitro storage artifact, drug effect and megaloblastic change.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic neutrophils are large with long, chain-like 6+ lobes rather than a radial rosette, and are accompanied by macro-ovalocytes.
ATLL flower cells are lymphocytes with scant agranular cytoplasm and hyperchromatic clover-leaf nuclei, not granulated neutrophils.
Aged samples show nuclear lobe separation and pyknosis along with echinocytes and vacuolation, and resolve on a fresh smear.
The constitutional form is lifelong, affects most neutrophils uniformly and lacks associated monocytic nuclear changes or an acute clinical trigger.

60876.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片幾乎完全被脂肪細胞取代，僅剩小血管、零星淋巴球/漿細胞與含棕色含鐵血黃素（hemosiderin）色素的巨噬細胞，看不到任何造血島或巨核細胞，符合再生不良性貧血。
features: Marrow space almost entirely replaced by adipocytes (profound hypocellularity)
Absence of recognizable erythroid islands, granulocytic precursors or megakaryocytes
Scattered residual small lymphocytes, plasma cells and stromal/endothelial cells
Macrophages containing coarse golden-brown cytoplasmic pigment (likely hemosiderin)
Small thick-walled arterioles and capillaries; no fibrosis, granulomas or abnormal infiltrate
60876.describe_en: High-power view of a hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow biopsy shows marrow space almost completely occupied by adipocytes. Residual cells are limited to scattered lymphocytes, plasma cells, endothelial cells and macrophages containing brown pigment, consistent with hemosiderin. No erythroid or granulocytic precursors, megakaryocytes, fibrosis, granulomas or abnormal infiltrate are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with severe marrow hypoplasia, in keeping with aplastic anemia in the appropriate clinical and peripheral blood context.

ddx.vs: Hypoplastic MDS retains clusters of dysplastic megakaryocytes or abnormally localized immature precursors, sometimes with reticulin fibrosis, and may show clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
Serous atrophy shows pale pink-blue extracellular gelatinous material between shrunken fat cells, which is absent here.

ddx.dx: Hypocellular (hypoplastic) acute leukemia or hairy cell leukemia
ddx.vs: Residual cells would include clusters of blasts (CD34+) or hairy cells (CD20+, annexin A1+) rather than only lymphocytes, plasma cells and macrophages.
Clinical history of cytotoxic therapy or a biopsy composed mainly of subcortical marrow must be excluded; true aplastic anemia is diffusely hypocellular throughout an adequate core.

60812.recognize_zh: 低倍下黏膜表面呈潰瘍、上方覆蓋纖維素樣壞死物，其下方為緻密、多形性的淋巴組織球浸潤，混有較大淡染細胞；需配合 EBER 與免疫染色才能確立 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍。
features: Ulcerated mucosal surface with overlying fibrinopurulent/fibrinoid debris (upper left)
Dense, band-like to diffuse polymorphous infiltrate beneath the ulcer
Mixture of small dark lymphocytes, histiocytes and scattered larger cells with pale nuclei
Scattered extravasated red cells and small vessels
Two parallel dark linear tissue folds (processing artifact)
60812.describe_en: Low-power H&E section shows an ulcerated mucosal surface covered by fibrinoid debris, with an underlying dense, polymorphous lymphohistiocytic infiltrate that includes scattered larger atypical cells. No intact surface epithelium is evident in this field, and the infiltrate is diffuse rather than nodular. Linear dark bands represent tissue-fold artifact. The architecture is suggestive of EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer in the appropriate clinical context, pending EBER ISH and immunophenotyping.

ddx.dx: Reactive/traumatic ulcer (eosinophilic ulcer of the tongue)
ddx.vs: Contains a mixed infiltrate with prominent eosinophils but lacks atypical Hodgkin-like large cells and EBER-positive cells.
Rarely presents as an isolated mucosal ulcer and shows scattered CD15+/CD30+ HRS cells with CD20 weak/negative, whereas EBVMCU large cells are usually CD20+ with many EBER+ small cells.
Shows angiocentric/angiodestructive growth with extensive necrosis and CD3/CD56+ EBER+ cells.
Would show invasive keratinizing epithelial nests (cytokeratin+) rather than a purely lymphohistiocytic infiltrate.

60620.recognize_zh: 周邊血中成群的中型淋巴細胞，核圓至卵圓、略偏心，染色質均勻細緻、無明顯核仁，胞質淡藍灰且邊緣有細長毛狀突起，是典型的毛細胞（hairy cells）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells, 1.5–2 times the size of small lymphocytes, with moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval or slightly indented nuclei, often eccentric
Homogeneous, finely stippled (ground-glass) chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate pale gray-blue cytoplasm with circumferential fine hair-like projections
Background red cells unremarkable; no granules or vacuoles in the lymphoid cells
60620.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval, somewhat eccentric nuclei, homogeneous finely dispersed chromatin, and absent or inconspicuous nucleoli. The cells have moderate amounts of pale gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular, circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections. Background red cells show no significant abnormality. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a distinct central nucleolus and are CD25- and annexin A1-negative with wild-type BRAF.

ddx.dx: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma with villous lymphocytes
ddx.vs: SMZL cells have short polar villi, more condensed chromatin and lack the CD103/CD25/CD11c triad.
LGLs have azurophilic granules and a T/NK phenotype, and reactive lymphocytes show cytoplasm hugging red cells without fine projections.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin, vacuoles and fine granules, and express CD14 rather than B-cell markers.

60684.recognize_zh: 巨噬細胞的細胞質被無數桿菌塞滿：螢光染色呈亮綠色、抗酸染色呈紅色；在 Romanowsky 染色下這些桿菌不著色，呈現細胞質中大量透明的「負影」桿狀結構，是分枝桿菌（常見於 MAC）的重要線索。
features: Panel A (fluorochrome, likely auramine): macrophage with cytoplasm packed by innumerable bright green fluorescent bacilli surrounding a dark nucleus
Panel B (acid-fast stain): macrophage filled with red-magenta acid-fast bacilli against a blue counterstain
Panel C (Romanowsky, low power): dark purple background with numerous clear rod-shaped 'negative images' and clear vacuoles
Panel D (Romanowsky, high power): enlarged macrophages with pale, finely striated cytoplasm containing unstained negative-image rods, adjacent to hematopoietic cells
Specimen source not labeled; appears to be an aspirate smear
60684.describe_en: Smear preparations show macrophages distended by innumerable slender bacilli. On Romanowsky staining, the organisms do not take up stain and appear as clear rod-shaped negative images within pale, striated macrophage cytoplasm and in the background. A fluorochrome stain shows the macrophage cytoplasm packed with brightly fluorescent bacilli, and an acid-fast stain confirms abundant red acid-fast rods. Findings are consistent with massive mycobacterial infection of macrophages, a pattern typical of disseminated Mycobacterium avium complex in an immunocompromised host; culture or PCR is needed for speciation.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm that is PAS positive but acid-fast negative, without discrete clear rods.
Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML or myeloma have similar striated cytoplasm but acid-fast and fluorochrome stains are negative.
Leishmania and Histoplasma appear as round or oval stained bodies (with kinetoplast or halo) rather than unstained slender rods, and are not acid-fast.
Tropheryma whipplei-laden macrophages are PAS positive and acid-fast negative, unlike these acid-fast bacilli.

60748.recognize_zh: 周邊血出現大量中大型、染色質細緻、細胞質深藍的母細胞樣細胞，容易誤認為急性白血病；組織切片為瀰漫性中大型細胞浸潤，染色體核型異常，FISH 顯示 MYC 斷裂與 BCL2/IGH 融合，證實為 MYC/BCL2 雙重打擊淋巴瘤/白血病。
features: Panel A (PB): numerous medium-to-large atypical cells with fine to slightly clumped chromatin, some with nucleoli, resembling blasts
Panel A: moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular angular contours; no granules or Auer rods
Panel B (tissue H&E): diffuse sheet of monotonous medium-sized cells with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Panel B inset: G-banded karyotype with structural abnormalities
Panel B inset: FISH with MYC break-apart split signals and BCL2/IGH dual-fusion (yellow fusion) signals
60748.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, closely mimicking blasts. The tissue biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of monotonous medium-sized cells. Cytogenetic studies show an abnormal karyotype, and FISH demonstrates a MYC rearrangement (break-apart) and BCL2::IGH fusion. Findings are consistent with high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (double-hit) in leukemic phase; flow cytometry for TdT/CD34 negativity and surface light chain helps exclude B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are TdT+/CD34+ with absent surface light chain, whereas double-hit lymphoma cells are mature (TdT−, sIg+) with MYC/BCL2 rearrangements (rare TdT+ cases exist, making FISH decisive).
Myeloblasts show MPO/CD33/CD117 positivity and may contain Auer rods, not B-cell markers.
Burkitt cells have vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm and isolated MYC::IG rearrangement without BCL2 rearrangement and are BCL2 negative.

60748.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; karyotype; FISH: MYC, BCL2/IGH

60556.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆偏藍紫色的多染性紅血球 (polychromatophilic RBC) 內，可見細線狀、扭成迴圈或 8 字形的紫紅色細環，這就是 Cabot 環；本圖未見說明中提到的箭頭，也無法清楚確認 Howell-Jolly 小體。
features: Polychromatophilic (bluish) red cell containing a thin, reddish-purple threadlike loop/figure-of-eight inclusion (Cabot ring)
Adjacent second polychromatophilic red cell without a definite inclusion
Background red cells with anisocytosis and occasional teardrop/tailed and spherocytic-appearing forms
Small dot-like density in one red cell is equivocal for a Howell-Jolly body at this resolution
No arrows are present in this image
60556.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mild anisopoikilocytosis with scattered polychromatophilic red cells and occasional tailed forms. One polychromatophilic red cell contains a delicate, threadlike, reddish-purple looped inclusion in a figure-of-eight configuration, characteristic of a Cabot ring. The arrows mentioned in the caption are not present on this image, and a Howell-Jolly body cannot be confidently identified. Findings are consistent with a Cabot ring in the setting of accelerated erythropoiesis, as seen in hemolytic or megaloblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: Malaria rings have a distinct blue cytoplasmic ring with one or two dense red chromatin dots, not a thin continuous figure-of-eight thread.
Babesia forms are small pleomorphic rings or tetrads (Maltese cross) with chromatin dots and no loop figure.
Basophilic stippling consists of multiple fine or coarse blue dots dispersed throughout the cell rather than a continuous thread.
Pappenheimer bodies are small peripheral clustered dots that stain with Prussian blue, not ring-shaped threads.

60492.recognize_zh: CD3 染色中，密集的中型腫瘤細胞呈顆粒狀、核周點狀的細胞質陽性（cytoplasmic CD3ε），而散在的正常小 T 細胞為較深且完整的膜性染色，呈「雙色調」差異，是 NK 細胞表型的線索。
features: Diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round to irregular nuclei
Granular, dot-like and perinuclear cytoplasmic CD3 staining in most neoplastic cells
Lack of crisp circumferential membranous staining in the neoplastic cells
Scattered cells with darker, more solid staining (reactive T cells) providing a two-tone contrast
Endothelial-lined vessel at upper left with negative spindle nuclei
60492.describe_en: CD3 immunostain shows a diffuse infiltrate of medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with granular and perinuclear cytoplasmic staining, without the crisp membranous pattern expected of mature T cells. Scattered admixed cells with darker, more uniform staining represent reactive T cells and create a two-tone pattern. This cytoplasmic CD3ε pattern in the absence of surface CD3 supports an NK-cell phenotype. With CD56, cytotoxic granule protein, and EBER positivity, findings are consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS cells usually show membranous surface CD3 and are EBER negative in most cases.
Shares cytoplasmic CD3ε/CD56/EBER positivity but presents as a systemic leukemic process with marrow and blood involvement rather than a localized nasal mass.
BPDCN is CD3 negative and expresses CD4, CD56, CD123, and TCF4 without EBV or cytotoxic granules.

60428.recognize_zh: 中倍下骨小樑兩側被深藍色的小淋巴球浸潤帶緊貼包圍（尤其骨小樑右側與左上），而遠離骨頭的區域則是含紅色顆粒球前驅細胞與巨核細胞的正常造血；這種沿骨小樑分布的淋巴浸潤是濾泡性淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓的招牌模式。
features: Hypercellular marrow with bony trabeculae and scant fat
Dense bands of small, dark lymphoid cells hugging and following the trabecular surfaces (paratrabecular infiltrate)
Clear contrast between the monotonous blue lymphoid band and the adjacent intertrabecular hematopoietic marrow
Residual hematopoiesis with eosinophilic granulocytic precursors and scattered megakaryocytes away from bone
Cytologic detail limited at this magnification
60428.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, low-medium power) shows a hypercellular marrow in which sheets of small, dark-staining lymphoid cells are applied directly to the surfaces of the bony trabeculae, forming broad paratrabecular bands. The intertrabecular spaces away from bone contain residual trilineage hematopoiesis, including granulocytic precursors and megakaryocytes. The lymphoid infiltrate is cytologically monotonous, although nuclear detail is limited at this power. The paratrabecular pattern is characteristic of bone marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed with immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Reactive aggregates are small, round, sharply circumscribed and intertrabecular, rather than broad bands spread along the trabecular surface.
MCL can show paratrabecular involvement but is CD5-positive and cyclin D1-positive with t(11;14).
The normal paratrabecular zone is a thin rim of maturing myeloid cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, not a thick band of dark, monotonous lymphocytes.

60364.recognize_zh: 四格圖：H&E 為成片小至中型、染色質細緻的母細胞並見核分裂；CD79a 瀰漫陽性、TdT 核陽性，而 CD34 在腫瘤細胞為陰性、只染到血管內皮（內部陽性對照），指向 CD34 陰性的 B 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: H&E: diffuse sheets of small-to-intermediate blasts with round to irregular/convoluted nuclei, fine chromatin, scant cytoplasm and scattered mitoses
CD79a: strong diffuse positivity in essentially all tumor cells (red chromogen)
TdT: diffuse nuclear positivity in the vast majority of cells
CD34: negative in the blasts; only endothelial cells of small vessels stain, serving as an internal positive control
60364.describe_en: The H&E section shows effacement by diffuse sheets of small-to-intermediate blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to irregular nuclear contours, finely dispersed chromatin and scattered mitotic figures. By immunohistochemistry, the neoplastic cells are diffusely positive for CD79a and show nuclear TdT expression. CD34 is negative in the blasts, with appropriate staining of endothelial cells as an internal control. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with a CD34-negative immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: Also TdT-positive, but T-LBL expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and is generally CD79a-negative (CD79a can rarely be aberrant), so a B-lineage panel including CD19/PAX5 is needed.
Burkitt lymphoma is TdT-negative with near-100% Ki-67 and a starry-sky pattern, whereas these blasts are diffusely TdT-positive.
Blastoid MCL is TdT-negative and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
AML blasts are CD79a-negative and express MPO, CD33 or CD117; TdT can be positive in a subset, so lineage markers rather than TdT decide.

60172.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片可見多個細胞核摺疊、腎形、細胞質灰藍並帶空泡的單核球，與顆粒球前驅細胞混雜；部分嗜中性球核分葉異常，提示慢性骨髓單核球性白血病（CMML）。
features: Increased monocytes with folded, reniform or indented nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm
Cytoplasmic vacuoles in several monocytic cells
Admixed granulated myelocytes and metamyelocytes (myeloid predominance)
Occasional neutrophil with abnormal nuclear segmentation, subtle dysgranulopoiesis
No obvious increase in blasts in this field
60172.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a myeloid-predominant population with numerous monocytes and monocytoid cells, characterized by folded or indented nuclei, delicate chromatin and abundant gray-blue, partly vacuolated cytoplasm. Maturing granulocytic precursors are admixed, and occasional neutrophils show subtle nuclear segmentation abnormalities. Blasts and promonocytes are not conspicuously increased in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, pending blast/promonocyte enumeration.

ddx.vs: AML requires ≥20% blasts plus promonocytes, which have finer chromatin, nucleoli and less nuclear folding than the mature monocytes seen here.
Reactive monocytosis lacks dysplasia in other lineages and clonal markers (e.g., TET2, SRSF2, ASXL1 mutations).
aCML has prominent dysgranulopoiesis with monocytes <10% of white cells.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia with monocytosis (p190 BCR-ABL1)
ddx.vs: BCR-ABL1 testing is required; CML typically shows basophilia and a left-shifted granulocytic bulge.

60108.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆大型芽細胞，核染色質細緻、細胞質深藍且邊緣有多個不規則的細胞質泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），血小板稀少；在唐氏症孩童身上要想到巨核母細胞（megakaryoblast）型的 ML-DS。
features: Single large blast, roughly 2.5–3 times the diameter of a red cell
High N:C ratio with round to slightly irregular nucleus and finely dispersed, open chromatin
Deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with irregular cytoplasmic blebs and pseudopod-like projections
Background red cells largely normocytic without significant poikilocytosis
Platelets appear reduced in this field
60108.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single circulating blast in a background of largely unremarkable normocytic red cells, with few platelets seen. The blast is large with a high N:C ratio, a round to slightly irregular nucleus, and fine open chromatin. The cytoplasm is deeply basophilic and agranular with irregular cytoplasmic blebs, a feature characteristic of megakaryoblasts. In a child with Down syndrome, findings are consistent with myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (megakaryoblastic phenotype).

ddx.vs: TAM shows identical megakaryoblasts but occurs in neonates within the first ~3 months and usually resolves spontaneously, so age and clinical course, not morphology, separate them.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia in a non-Down syndrome patient
ddx.vs: Blast morphology is indistinguishable; absence of constitutional trisomy 21 and presence of other genetic lesions (e.g., CBFA2T3::GLIS2) define the non-DS entity.
Lymphoblasts typically have scant cytoplasm without blebbing and are TdT/CD19 or cCD3 positive, whereas megakaryoblasts express CD41/CD61.

27212.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片呈模糊的無定形嗜鹼性背景，細胞輪廓不清、核固縮或溶解（ghost cells）；切片中骨小樑之間的骨髓大片呈淡粉紅色壞死（星號），僅少部分殘存有活性細胞（箭頭），而殘存腫瘤細胞免疫染色呈瀰漫強陽性——急性骨髓性白血病合併骨髓壞死。
features: Panel A (aspirate, low power): amorphous granular basophilic-to-eosinophilic background with indistinct cell outlines
Panel B (aspirate, high power): degenerated 'ghost' cells with smudged, pyknotic or karyorrhectic nuclei and vacuolated debris
Panel C (H&E biopsy): extensive coagulative marrow necrosis (asterisk) with loss of nuclear detail between bony trabeculae
Panel C: residual viable cellular marrow in an adjacent intertrabecular space (arrow)
Panel D (IHC): diffuse strong cytoplasmic staining of the viable leukemic infiltrate (marker not labeled)
27212.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (A, B) consist largely of amorphous, granular necrotic material with degenerated cells showing indistinct cytoplasmic borders and smudged or pyknotic nuclei, precluding a reliable differential count. The trephine biopsy (C) shows extensive coagulative necrosis of intertrabecular marrow (asterisk) with a residual focus of viable hypercellular marrow (arrow); bone trabeculae appear intact. Immunohistochemistry (D; antibody not labeled) shows diffuse strong staining of the viable leukemic cells. Findings are consistent with bone marrow necrosis secondary to acute myeloid leukemia (reported as acute myelomonocytic leukemia); lineage and subtype should be established on viable tissue, peripheral blood or repeat sampling.

ddx.vs: Viable tumor at the necrotic edge is cohesive and keratin-positive, CD45- and myeloid marker-negative.

ddx.dx: Sickle cell crisis or DIC-related marrow infarction
ddx.vs: Infarction in these settings lacks a viable blast population and is associated with sickled cells or consumptive coagulopathy.
Gelatinous transformation shows fat atrophy with pale extracellular mucopolysaccharide (Alcian blue-positive) and preserved but hypocellular cells, not ghost cells.

ddx.dx: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia or high-grade lymphoma with necrosis
ddx.vs: Viable lymphoblasts or lymphoma cells express TdT/CD19/CD3 or CD20 and lack myeloid/monocytic markers.

3404.recognize_zh: 許多紅血球周邊有成群、細小不規則的藍紫色顆粒（Pappenheimer bodies），和單一圓形、邊界平整的深色 Howell-Jolly 小體不同；背景有標靶細胞、拉長紅血球與一個有核紅血球，符合鐮刀型貧血脾功能喪失後的血片。
features: Many red cells with small, multiple, irregular basophilic granules clustered near the cell periphery (Pappenheimer bodies)
Occasional red cells with a single, round, smooth-bordered dense purple inclusion (Howell-Jolly body)
Nucleated red blood cell with dense pyknotic nucleus
Target cells, elongated/boat-shaped cells and scattered polychromatic macrocytes
Background features of hyposplenism
3404.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous erythrocytes containing multiple small, irregular basophilic granules clustered toward the cell margin, consistent with Pappenheimer bodies. Scattered cells contain a single round, dense Howell-Jolly body. There are target cells, elongated boat-shaped red cells, occasional polychromatic cells and a nucleated red blood cell. In a patient with sickle cell disease, findings are consistent with functional asplenia; confirmation of iron-containing inclusions requires a Prussian blue (siderocyte) stain.

ddx.vs: Howell-Jolly bodies are single, round, larger DNA remnants with smooth borders and are Prussian blue negative, whereas Pappenheimer bodies are multiple, small, irregular and iron positive.
Basophilic stippling consists of fine or coarse dots evenly distributed throughout the whole cell and is Prussian blue negative.
Superimposed platelets are larger, granular and have a surrounding clear halo, often lying in a different focal plane.
Precipitate is refractile, lies on and between cells, and does not respect cell margins.

3980.recognize_zh: 數個紅血球內可見成團、較粗大不規則的深藍紫色顆粒（Pappenheimer bodies），另有些細胞呈散在的細小點狀（疑似嗜鹼性點彩）；背景有大量標靶細胞（上方箭頭）與拉長的鐮刀／船形紅血球（下方箭頭），符合鐮刀型貧血。
features: Coarse, irregular basophilic granules in small clusters within several red cells (Pappenheimer bodies)
Some red cells with finer punctate dots scattered across the cell, possibly representing basophilic stippling
Numerous target cells (upper arrow)
Elongated boat-shaped sickle cell (lower arrow)
Occasional poikilocytes with irregular outlines
3980.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows abundant target cells and an elongated boat-shaped sickle form. Several erythrocytes contain clustered, coarse, irregular basophilic granules consistent with Pappenheimer bodies, and a few show finer dots distributed across the cell that may represent basophilic stippling. On Wright stain alone these two inclusions cannot be fully separated; a Prussian blue stain will identify the iron-positive Pappenheimer bodies. Findings are consistent with sickle cell disease with hyposplenism.

ddx.vs: Stippling is evenly dispersed throughout the red cell and is Prussian blue negative, whereas Pappenheimer bodies are clustered and iron positive.
Howell-Jolly bodies are single, round, smooth-contoured nuclear remnants rather than multiple irregular granules.
Hb SC shows target cells with fewer classic sickle forms and characteristic crystal or 'Washington monument' cells; Hb HPLC separates them.

25164.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個巨噬細胞內塞滿大量大小一致、約 2–4 µm 的卵圓形酵母菌，每個周圍有透明暈圈，一端可見新月形深染核質，無動基體（kinetoplast），符合莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）。
features: Macrophage distended by numerous small, uniform oval yeast forms (about 2–4 µm)
Each yeast with a clear halo (pseudocapsule) and a crescent-shaped basophilic nuclear cap at one pole
No kinetoplast, septation or budding with broad base identified
Occasional yeast forms also within an adjacent vacuolated macrophage
Background marrow cells including erythroid precursors and myeloid cells
25164.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows a macrophage packed with numerous small, uniform oval intracellular yeasts measuring approximately 2–4 µm, each surrounded by a clear halo and containing an eccentric crescent of basophilic nuclear material. No kinetoplasts are identified. Similar organisms are seen in an adjacent vacuolated macrophage. In an immunocompromised patient with untreated HIV, findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis; confirmation by GMS/PAS stain, culture and Histoplasma urine antigen is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have both a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a clear halo, and are GMS negative.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and include elongated sausage forms.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus, lack a halo and are GMS negative.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size (4–10 µm) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding.

21260.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片中大量單一形態的大型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、偏大、可見明顯核仁，細胞質中等量偏藍，部分有細小空泡，缺乏正常小淋巴球與單核球背景，提示瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的中樞神經侵犯。
features: Monotonous population of large lymphoid cells, about 2-3 times the size of a small lymphocyte
Round to slightly indented nuclei with vesicular chromatin and one or more distinct nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm, some cells with fine cytoplasmic vacuoles
Cells crowded together with artifactual flattening from cytocentrifugation but no true cohesive molding
Few background small lymphocytes or monocytes
21260.describe_en: CSF cytospin preparation is hypercellular and composed of a monotonous population of large atypical lymphoid cells with round nuclei, vesicular chromatin, distinct nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some with fine vacuoles. Cells are crowded by cytocentrifugation without true epithelial cohesion, and normal small lymphocytes and monocytes are sparse. Findings are consistent with leptomeningeal involvement by large B-cell lymphoma; confirmation by CSF flow cytometry demonstrating a light chain-restricted CD19/CD20-positive population is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive CSF shows a mixed population of small lymphocytes, activated lymphocytes and monocytes rather than a monotonous large-cell population.
Carcinoma cells form true three-dimensional cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and are cytokeratin-positive.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with deeply basophilic, heavily vacuolated cytoplasm, and lymphoblasts have fine chromatin and TdT positivity.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof and a CD38/CD138-positive phenotype.

17100.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中大量破碎紅血球（schistocytes），包括頭盔形、三角形與不規則碎片，並有小球形紅血球；視野中血小板極少。在使用 mitomycin 的病人身上，符合藥物相關血栓性微血管病（thrombotic microangiopathy）造成的血小板低下與溶血性貧血。
features: Numerous schistocytes: helmet cells, triangular and irregular fragments scattered throughout
Microspherocytes lacking central pallor among the red cells
Many residual RBCs show central pallor with mild anisocytosis
Markedly decreased platelets in the field
Single small lymphocyte at center; no leukoerythroblastic cells or tumor cells identified
17100.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked red cell fragmentation with numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells, triangular forms and irregular fragments, accompanied by microspherocytes and mild anisocytosis. Platelets are markedly decreased. A single small lymphocyte is present and no circulating tumor cells or nucleated red cells are seen in this field. In a patient receiving mitomycin, findings are consistent with drug-associated thrombotic microangiopathy (microangiopathic hemolytic anemia with thrombocytopenia).

ddx.vs: Smear morphology is identical; severe ADAMTS13 deficiency (<10%) distinguishes TTP from drug-associated TMA.
DIC also produces schistocytes but shows prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen and elevated D-dimer, which are usually normal in drug-induced TMA.
Metastatic carcinoma-related MAHA often shows leukoerythroblastosis with nucleated RBCs and immature granulocytes, which are not seen here.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes and polychromasia with a positive DAT but lacks abundant fragmented cells.

15116.recognize_zh: 四張口唇照片：A 圖唇部白色細網狀角化紋（lichenoid change）；B 圖唇緣紅腫、糜爛並見舌背白色苔蘚樣斑塊；C 圖唇部與唇緣紅斑合併舌面變化；D 圖唇部脫屑、結痂的唇炎。唇部苔蘚樣變化與糜爛是慢性移植物抗宿主病（cGVHD）口腔侵犯的表現。
features: A: fine white reticular (lichenoid) hyperkeratotic striae on the lower lip vermilion
B: erythematous, eroded lip margins with a white lichenoid plaque-like change on the dorsal tongue
C: erythema and small erosions along the lip vermilion border with patchy changes of the tongue surface
D: cheilitis with scaling, crusting and white keratotic flakes on erythematous lips
Clinical photographs only; no histology
15116.describe_en: Composite clinical photographs of the lips in chronic graft-versus-host disease. Panel A shows fine white reticular hyperkeratotic striae on the vermilion, a lichenoid pattern. Panels B and C show erythema and erosions of the lip margins, with lichenoid white changes on the tongue in B. Panel D shows cheilitis with scaling, crusting and keratotic flakes. Lichen planus-like changes of the oral mucosa are diagnostic features of chronic GVHD by NIH criteria, whereas erythema and erosions alone are distinctive but not diagnostic.

ddx.vs: Clinical and histologic appearance can be identical, so distinction depends on the history of allogeneic transplantation and other organ manifestations of cGVHD.
HSV produces clustered vesicles that ulcerate with scalloped borders and is confirmed by PCR or viral culture, rather than reticular white striae.
Pseudomembranous candidiasis forms white plaques that wipe off leaving erythematous mucosa and shows hyphae on smear.
Mucositis occurs early after conditioning with diffuse ulceration, and lacks lichenoid striae or late onset.

captions: A: Lichenoid white striae on lip vermilion
B: Eroded erythematous lips with lichenoid tongue changes
C: Erythema and erosions of the lip margins
D: Scaling and crusted cheilitis

13836.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中，在正常骨髓系與紅血球系前驅細胞之間，箭頭指向兩個小型淋巴樣細胞，核深染、染色質濃縮，核輪廓有凹陷或裂痕（cleaved/notched），胞質極少，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤的中心細胞（centrocyte）浸潤。
features: Small lymphoid cells (arrow) about the size of a red cell, with very high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm
Nuclei with condensed chromatin and irregular contours with notches or clefts
No visible nucleoli in the arrowed cells
Background of normal trilineage hematopoiesis: myelocytes, promyelocytes, band neutrophils and erythroblasts
Isolated small lymphoid cells rather than sheets in this field
13836.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows trilineage hematopoiesis with myeloid precursors at various stages and erythroblasts. Interspersed are small lymphoid cells (arrow) with scant cytoplasm, condensed chromatin and irregular, notched or cleaved nuclear contours without nucleoli. Blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by a small cleaved-cell lymphoma, consistent with follicular lymphoma in the appropriate context; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD10+, CD19+, CD20+, light-chain restriction), trephine biopsy for paratrabecular aggregates and BCL2 rearrangement studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Normal lymphocytes and hematogones have smooth round nuclei without clefts, and hematogones show a maturing polytypic phenotype on flow cytometry.
Mantle cells can have slightly irregular nuclei but are CD5+ and cyclin D1+ with t(11;14), rather than CD10+ BCL6+ with t(14;18).
CLL cells have round nuclei with block-like soccer-ball chromatin and are CD5+ CD23+, lacking nuclear clefts.

12428.recognize_zh: 抹片中大量中型母細胞，核形不規則、染色質細緻，胞質灰藍色、無顆粒，並常見偏向一側的胞質突起或尾巴（pseudopod / tail），這種「灰藍無顆粒胞質＋偽足」提示母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤（BPDCN）。
features: Numerous medium-sized blasts with irregular, angulated to indented nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Moderate pale gray-blue agranular cytoplasm, often eccentric with pseudopod-like tails or projections
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules in the blasts
Background with residual segmented neutrophils, small dark round nuclei (lymphocytes/orthochromatic normoblasts)
12428.describe_en: The aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen infiltrated by numerous medium-sized blasts. The blasts have irregular to indented nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, and moderate gray-blue agranular cytoplasm frequently forming unipolar pseudopod-like projections. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are absent. Residual neutrophils and erythroid precursors are present. Findings are suggestive of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm; confirmation requires immunophenotyping (CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4, TCL1, CD303) with negative MPO and lineage markers.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes have folded nuclei and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles and are NSE/CD14/CD64/lysozyme positive, while BPDCN is CD123/TCF4/TCL1 positive and NSE-negative.

ddx.dx: AML with minimal differentiation / NK-lymphoblastic leukemia
ddx.vs: Agranular blasts are morphologically similar, so flow cytometry is required: BPDCN is CD4+CD56+CD123 bright with CD303, lacking CD34 in most cases and myeloid markers.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm without pseudopods and express TdT with B or T lineage markers, whereas BPDCN has more cytoplasm and a plasmacytoid dendritic cell phenotype.

3724.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆大型組織球，胞質豐富呈灰藍色、邊界不規則，內含許多灰綠到深色的圓形吞噬顆粒與空泡，核卵圓偏心，周圍環繞顆粒球與紅血球前驅細胞，是巨噬細胞（histiocyte）的典型外觀。
features: Large cell with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and irregular, ill-defined borders
Cytoplasm filled with numerous round gray-green to dark phagocytic granules/globules and small vacuoles
Single oval nucleus with fine, lacy chromatin and an inconspicuous nucleolus
Low N:C ratio
Surrounding myelocytes, a band neutrophil, erythroid precursors and erythrocytes
3724.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm and irregular borders, containing numerous round gray-green to dark phagocytic inclusions and small vacuoles. The nucleus is oval with fine lacy chromatin and an inconspicuous nucleolus. No engulfed intact blood cells or organisms are evident. Surrounding cells include maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. Findings are consistent with a marrow histiocyte (macrophage) containing phagocytosed debris.

ddx.vs: Sea-blue histiocytes have cytoplasm filled with uniformly sea-blue ceroid granules rather than gray-green globules of varying density.
Hemophagocytes show recognizable ingested erythrocytes, platelets or nucleated cells.
Mast cells are smaller with round central nuclei and cytoplasm packed with dark purple metachromatic granules.
Pseudo-Gaucher cells show fibrillary striated cytoplasm without discrete globular inclusions.

1100.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中嗜酸性系細胞明顯增多，可見大量含橘紅色顆粒的成熟及未成熟嗜酸性球（嗜酸性骨髓球），部分未成熟細胞混有深紫色顆粒；原始細胞並未明顯增加，符合 HES 骨髓的嗜酸性增生。
features: Marked increase in eosinophilic lineage cells at all stages of maturation
Eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with round to indented nuclei and orange-red granules
Some immature eosinophils contain admixed dark purple (basophilic-appearing) granules
Mature eosinophils with bilobed nuclei and abundant specific granules
Occasional larger mononuclear cells with fine chromatin and scattered erythroid precursors; blasts not obviously increased
1100.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows a striking increase in eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors at all stages of maturation, including myelocytes and metamyelocytes with orange-red granules, some with admixed dark purple immature granules. Occasional larger mononuclear cells and erythroid precursors are present; blasts do not appear substantially increased in this field. Findings are consistent with marked eosinophilic hyperplasia; idiopathic hypereosinophilic syndrome is a diagnosis of exclusion requiring blast count, cytogenetics, FISH/RT-PCR for PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1 and JAK2 rearrangements, mast cell assessment and T-cell clonality studies.

ddx.vs: May look identical, often with increased spindled mast cells; confirmed by detection of FIP1L1::PDGFRA.
Requires evidence of clonality or increased blasts with dysplasia, which morphology alone in this field does not show.
Shows abnormal eosinophils with large purple-violet granules plus increased myelomonocytic blasts (≥20% or diagnostic genetics).
Features spindle-shaped, CD25/CD117-positive mast cell aggregates and KIT D816V mutation.

2124.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結免疫染色可見多個棕色深染的圓形結節（濾泡狀區）與其間大片淡染、擴張的濾泡間／副皮質區交錯，呈現結構保留但副皮質明顯擴大的反應性增生，這是 ALPS 淋巴結的整體架構。本圖未標示抗體名稱，解讀需搭配染色資訊。
features: Low-power lymph node section with preserved nodular architecture
Multiple round, strongly and diffusely brown-staining nodules consistent with follicles (pattern suggests a B-cell marker, antibody not stated)
Broad, paler interfollicular/paracortical zones containing only scattered positive cells, indicating marked paracortical expansion
Scattered small vessels and open spaces within the interfollicular areas
No effacement of architecture by a diffuse sheet of positive cells
2124.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node shows preserved architecture with multiple strongly positive nodules corresponding to follicles, separated by broad, expanded interfollicular/paracortical zones that contain only scattered positive cells. The antibody is not specified in the image; the follicular distribution suggests a B-cell marker such as CD20, which would indicate that the expanded paracortex is composed of non-B cells. The architecture is not effaced. In the appropriate clinical context, the pattern of follicular hyperplasia with marked paracortical expansion is consistent with autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome, pending demonstration of CD4-/CD8- TCRαβ+ double-negative T cells.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma shows back-to-back crowded follicles effacing the node with BCL2-positive germinal centers, whereas here follicles are separated by broad expanded interfollicular zones.
AITL shows effaced architecture with expanded CD21+ follicular dendritic cell meshworks and atypical PD1+/CD10+ T cells, which requires additional stains to exclude.

ddx.dx: Nonspecific reactive follicular and paracortical hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar, so separation from ALPS requires flow cytometry for elevated double-negative T cells and biomarkers such as elevated FASL, IL-10, and vitamin B12.

2124.stain: IHC: marker not specified (likely B-cell marker)

1548.recognize_zh: 周邊血片紅血球大致正常大小與顏色，但整片看不到任何多染性紅血球（polychromasia），也沒有有核紅血球或破碎紅血球，白血球（一顆嗜中性球、一顆淋巴球）與血小板形態正常；網狀紅血球缺乏正是純紅血球再生不良（PRCA）在血片上的線索。
features: Red cells predominantly normocytic and normochromic with mild anisocytosis
Complete absence of polychromatophilic red cells, indicating reticulocytopenia
No nucleated red cells, schistocytes, or spherocytes
One segmented neutrophil and one small lymphocyte with normal morphology
Occasional normal-appearing platelets
1548.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with mild anisocytosis and a striking absence of polychromatophilic cells. No nucleated red cells, schistocytes, or spherocytes are seen. Neutrophils, lymphocytes, and platelets appear morphologically unremarkable. The smear is not diagnostic on its own, but the lack of polychromasia in an anemic patient supports reticulocytopenic anemia; in this context findings are consistent with pure red cell aplasia, with confirmation by reticulocyte count, marrow examination for giant pronormoblasts, and parvovirus B19 PCR.

ddx.dx: Anemia of chronic disease / renal anemia
ddx.vs: These also show normocytic red cells with low reticulocytes, so separation depends on marrow erythroid precursors being present rather than absent and on iron studies and erythropoietin levels.
Aplastic anemia shows concurrent neutropenia and thrombocytopenia, whereas PRCA spares granulocytes and platelets.
Hemolysis shows polychromasia, spherocytes, or schistocytes, which are absent here, unless complicated by a parvovirus aplastic crisis.

1164.recognize_zh: 視野中央是一顆遠大於周圍顆粒球的巨大細胞，核呈多葉相連、染色質粗，胞質大量且充滿細小嗜天青顆粒；這是成熟巨核細胞（mature megakaryocyte）的標準樣貌，周圍是正常成熟的顆粒球系。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Multilobated, connected nuclear lobes with coarse, condensed chromatin
Abundant pale lilac cytoplasm filled with fine azurophilic granules (granular/platelet-producing stage)
Surrounding granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands) with normal granulation
Occasional erythroid precursors in a background of proteinaceous material
1164.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mature megakaryocyte with a large multilobated nucleus composed of connected lobes with coarse chromatin and abundant finely granular cytoplasm, corresponding to the granular platelet-producing stage. The surrounding cells show orderly granulocytic maturation with normal granulation and scattered erythroid precursors. No dysplastic megakaryocytic features, such as separated lobes or hypolobation, are seen. Findings represent a normal mature megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate, uniform round nuclei rather than a single lobulated nucleus with connected lobes.

ddx.dx: Dysplastic megakaryocyte with separated nuclear lobes
ddx.vs: Dysplastic forms show widely separated, round nuclear lobes or hypolobation, unlike the connected lobulated nucleus seen here.
MPN megakaryocytes are enlarged, hyperlobated or bulbous and cluster together on biopsy, whereas this single megakaryocyte has normal lobation.

1228.recognize_zh: 箭頭指出數顆散在的大型異型細胞，體積遠大於周圍骨髓細胞，胞質藍灰且含多個明顯空泡，核大、染色質細緻；在稀釋的抽吸液背景中找到這些大型空泡化異常細胞，是 ALCL 骨髓浸潤的線索，需 CD30/ALK 染色確認。
features: Scattered large atypical cells (arrows), several times the size of adjacent marrow cells
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with multiple distinct clear vacuoles
Large round to irregular nuclei with finely granular chromatin
Tumor cells present singly rather than in cohesive clusters
Hemodilute background with small lymphocytes, maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors
1228.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hemodilute and shows scattered large atypical cells, indicated by arrows, that are several times the size of surrounding hematopoietic cells. These cells have large round to irregular nuclei with finely granular chromatin and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing multiple clear vacuoles; they occur singly rather than as cohesive clusters. The background contains maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes. The findings are consistent with marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-positive, which should be confirmed by CD30 and ALK immunohistochemistry on the core biopsy, as marrow involvement may be subtle.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells tend to form cohesive clumps and are keratin-positive and CD30/ALK-negative.
Histiocytes have small bland nuclei and cytoplasm containing phagocytosed cells or debris, rather than large atypical nuclei with clear vacuoles.
DLBCL cells can look similar but express CD20/PAX5 and are ALK-negative with weaker, variable CD30.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei with granular cytoplasm and osteoclasts have multiple separate nuclei, unlike these mononuclear vacuolated cells.

4236.recognize_zh: 右上與下方兩顆細胞核圓、染色質細緻，淡藍胞質四周有明顯細長的毛狀突起，是很清楚的毛狀細胞；左上另一顆細胞核較不規則、染色質較粗。
features: Two medium-sized cells with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and no conspicuous nucleoli
Pale blue-gray cytoplasm with prominent fine, radiating circumferential hair-like projections
A third lymphoid cell at upper left with slightly irregular nucleus and more clumped chromatin
Background normocytic red cells and platelets without significant abnormality
4236.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and pale gray-blue cytoplasm bearing prominent fine circumferential hair-like projections. An additional lymphoid cell with a slightly irregular nucleus and coarser chromatin is present at the upper left. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with circulating hairy cells, suggestive of hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: SMZL villous lymphocytes have short villi concentrated at one or both poles and are CD103/CD25/CD123 negative.
HCL-v cells show a prominent single nucleolus and lack CD25, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.
Artifactual cytoplasmic fraying occurs at the feathered edge and in otherwise small mature lymphocytes, whereas hairy cells show projections throughout the smear with fine chromatin.

4172.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以大量母細胞為主（核圓、染色質細緻、胞質灰藍中等量），箭頭指向一顆核偏位、胞質深藍並有核旁淡染區的漿細胞，同一抹片同時看到急性骨髓性白血病的母細胞與骨髓瘤的漿細胞。
features: Markedly increased blasts: medium-to-large, round nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli
Blasts with moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm
Arrow marks a plasma cell with eccentric nucleus, deep blue cytoplasm and perinuclear hof
Scattered segmented neutrophils and small mature lymphocytes
Hypercellular smear with few red cells between nucleated cells
4172.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and dominated by blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, occasional nucleoli and moderate grey-blue cytoplasm. Scattered segmented neutrophils and small lymphocytes are present. The arrow indicates a plasma cell with an eccentric nucleus, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof; a few similar plasma cells are nearby. Auer rods are not evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia coexisting with a plasma cell neoplasm, and flow cytometry (myeloid blast phenotype and clonal CD138+/CD38+ plasma cells) is needed to confirm both populations.

ddx.vs: Plasmablasts are CD138+/CD38+ with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm, whereas AML blasts are CD34/CD117/MPO-positive and CD138-negative.
Plasma cell leukemia shows circulating clonal plasma cells without a separate myeloid blast population.
t-AML after alkylator or lenalidomide therapy for myeloma is morphologically identical and is defined by treatment history and often complex/TP53 cytogenetics.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic by kappa/lambda staining, while myeloma plasma cells are light-chain restricted.

4044.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的紅血球一側被切掉、呈直線邊緣與兩個尖角，是盔甲狀裂紅血球（helmet cell）；視野中另有數個三角形碎片與小球形紅血球，符合裂紅血球（schistocyte）。
features: Helmet-shaped schistocyte (arrow) with a straight cut edge and two pointed horns
Several additional helmet cells and small triangular fragments scattered in the field
Occasional small dense microspherocytes
A few red cells with irregular or target-like central staining
Few platelets visible; a partially visible leukocyte at upper left corner
4044.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several schistocytes, including helmet cells with straight edges and pointed projections as well as small triangular fragments and scattered microspherocytes. The remaining red cells are largely normochromic with a few irregular forms, and platelets appear sparse. Schistocytes result from mechanical shearing of red cells across fibrin strands or abnormal surfaces. Findings are consistent with red cell fragmentation, as seen in microangiopathic hemolytic anemia such as thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura.

ddx.vs: Keratocytes retain a round outline with two horn-like projections flanking a blister-like vacuole and are considered precursors of fragments, though counted with schistocytes in ICSH guidance.
Bite cells show a semicircular smooth notch rather than a straight shear edge with sharp corners.
Spherocytes are round, uniformly dense cells without angular edges, and the DAT is usually positive.
Artifactual fragments cluster at the feathered edge, whereas true schistocytes are distributed in the monolayer.

3788.recognize_zh: 這顆淋巴球核不規則、細胞質很少，但在細胞質下緣可見一顆單獨的圓形紫紅色包涵體，符合 Chediak-Higashi 症候群淋巴球的巨大顆粒。
features: Small-to-intermediate lymphocyte with a scant rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Single round, well-circumscribed reddish-purple cytoplasmic inclusion near the lower cell edge
Irregular, indented nucleus with condensed chromatin
No other abnormal granules in the cytoplasm
Thick area of smear with overlapping red cells and scattered platelets
3788.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a thick area with overlapping red cells, shows a lymphocyte with an irregular nucleus and scant pale cytoplasm containing a single, sharply defined, round azurophilic inclusion. The inclusion is larger than the fine granules of normal large granular lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with the giant cytoplasmic granule of Chediak-Higashi syndrome; confirmation by review of neutrophils and genetic testing (LYST) is appropriate.

ddx.vs: LGLs have more abundant cytoplasm with multiple fine azurophilic granules rather than one large inclusion.
An overlying platelet has a granular center with a pale hyalomere and lies outside the focal plane of the cytoplasm.
Alder-Reilly granules are numerous dense granules in all leukocytes rather than a solitary giant granule.

3596.recognize_zh: 細胞核不規則折疊、染色質細緻，細胞質灰藍色且有許多大小不一的明顯空泡，這是單核球（帶空泡、可能是活化狀態）；背景有細小顆粒狀雜點，在這個倍率下無法確定是染劑沉澱還是細菌。
features: Monocyte with irregularly folded, lobulated nucleus
Fine, lacy chromatin without nucleoli
Grey-blue cytoplasm with numerous clear vacuoles of variable size
Moderate N:C ratio; cell border slightly irregular
Background with fine rod-like and punctate particulate material (stain precipitate versus bacteria, not resolvable)
3596.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a monocyte with an irregularly folded nucleus, fine lacy chromatin, and grey-blue cytoplasm containing numerous clear vacuoles. The background contains fine punctate and short rod-like particles whose nature cannot be determined at this resolution; stain precipitate is most likely, but extracellular bacteria should be considered if clinically indicated. Prominent cytoplasmic vacuolization of monocytes may be seen in activated states, sepsis, or storage artifact. Findings are consistent with a vacuolated monocyte.

ddx.vs: Toxic neutrophils have segmented nuclei with clumped chromatin and pink cytoplasm with toxic granules.
Macrophages are larger with abundant cytoplasm and often phagocytosed debris, and are uncommon in peripheral blood.
Delayed processing produces vacuolization in many leukocytes along with nuclear lobulation and pyknosis, so a fresh smear resolves it.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply punched-out vacuoles and a round nucleus with nucleoli.

3660.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量核圓而濃縮、細胞質由深藍到灰粉紅的紅血球母細胞（normoblasts）成群分布，數量明顯多於顆粒球，並可見含深色鐵顆粒的巨噬細胞，符合紅血球系增生。
features: Numerous erythroid precursors at all stages, predominantly polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts
Round central nuclei with condensed checkerboard chromatin and basophilic to grey-pink cytoplasm
Occasional larger proerythroblasts/basophilic normoblasts with deep blue cytoplasm
Granulocytic precursors relatively reduced, giving a decreased M:E ratio
Macrophage with dark green-black pigment (hemosiderin) near the top of the field
Normoblastic maturation without obvious megaloblastic change or multinucleation
3660.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field with a marked increase in erythroid precursors at all stages of maturation, predominantly polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts, resulting in a decreased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio. Erythroid maturation appears normoblastic without significant megaloblastic change, nuclear budding or multinucleation at this magnification. A macrophage containing coarse dark pigment is present. Findings are consistent with erythroid hyperplasia, as seen in hemolysis, blood loss or other causes of increased erythropoietic drive; iron stain and clinical correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Erythroid precursors are larger with open, sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, accompanied by giant metamyelocytes.
Shows dyserythropoiesis (nuclear budding, multinucleation, ring sideroblasts) with dysplasia in other lineages and often increased myeloblasts.
Is dominated by sheets of highly immature proerythroblasts with vacuolated deep blue cytoplasm (≥30% pronormoblasts, usually with TP53 mutation), not maturing normoblasts.

3468.recognize_zh: 大型原始細胞有圓或略呈腎形的核、細緻染色質，以及量多的灰藍色細胞質帶細小空泡，外觀很像單核母細胞（monoblasts）；但本題歸類於前驅淋巴腫瘤，提醒這種「細胞質豐富」的 ALL 易被誤認為 AMoL，必須以流式或細胞化學確認。
features: Large blasts with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly reniform nuclei with finely granular, dispersed chromatin
Inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Fine cytoplasmic vacuoles in several cells; no Auer rods or distinct granules
Background of small mature lymphocytes and a few neutrophil precursors
3468.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows large blasts with round to slightly reniform nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small or inconspicuous nucleoli and abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine vacuoles. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are not identified, and small mature lymphocytes are scattered in the background. The abundant cytoplasm and vacuolation mimic monoblasts, although the case is classified under precursor lymphoid neoplasms. Morphology cannot assign lineage here; flow cytometry, TdT and nonspecific esterase/MPO cytochemistry are needed to distinguish B-lymphoblastic leukemia from acute monoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts are nonspecific esterase positive and CD14/CD64/CD11b/lysozyme positive, whereas lymphoblasts are TdT, CD19, CD10 or cCD3 positive and esterase negative.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and a mature CD20+/sIg+ TdT-negative phenotype with MYC rearrangement.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei, a perinuclear hof and deeper basophilic cytoplasm and express CD138/CD38 with light chain restriction.

3212.recognize_zh: 腎絲球的微血管環被大型異型細胞撐大填滿，核大、空泡狀染色質、核仁明顯，周圍仍可見 Bowman 腔與腎小管，顯示腫瘤細胞侷限在絲球體微血管內，符合血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤侵犯腎臟。
features: Enlarged, hypercellular glomerulus surrounded by Bowman space and capsule
Glomerular capillary loops distended by large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli
Tumor cells confined to capillary lumina without extravascular sheets
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and occasional perinuclear clearing in tumor cells
Adjacent renal tubules and interstitium without a mass-forming infiltrate
3212.describe_en: Renal tissue section shows a glomerulus with capillary loops markedly distended by large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli. The cells are confined within the capillary lumina, and Bowman space and the adjacent tubules are preserved without an extravascular tumor mass. Findings are consistent with renal (glomerular) involvement by intravascular large B-cell lymphoma; CD20 immunostaining would highlight the intracapillary cells and help exclude an endocapillary proliferative glomerulonephritis.

ddx.vs: Endocapillary GN shows neutrophils, monocytes and mesangial/endothelial cells that are small and bland, not large atypical cells with prominent nucleoli, and is CD20-.
Cryoglobulinemic GN has intracapillary PAS+ hyaline pseudothrombi and monocyte influx rather than large lymphoma cells filling loops.
TMA shows fibrin thrombi, fragmented red cells and endothelial swelling without an atypical lymphoid population.
Leukemic infiltrates are predominantly interstitial and involve peripheral blood, rather than being selectively intraglomerular large B cells.

3148.recognize_zh: 兩顆被紅血球擠壓變形的小至中型淋巴樣細胞，染色質均勻、濃縮而平滑（無明顯核仁），胞質極少僅剩一圈淡藍色邊，符合正常B前驅細胞血原母細胞（hematogone），旁邊是一顆嗜中性球作為大小對照。
features: Two small to intermediate lymphoid cells deformed and molded by adjacent red cells
Very high N:C ratio with only a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Homogeneous, smooth, moderately condensed chromatin
No visible nucleoli
